  - **Phase 12 visual pass — crit-specific hit spark.** `Theme.particle.critSpark` existed in `theme.js` but was never referenced anywhere; the hit-flash rising-edge branch now checks a new `e._lastHitCrit` flag (set once, at the same site `crit` is computed, by each of the four player-damage call sites in `combat-1.js`/`combat-2.js` (×2)/`combat-3.js` — search `_lastHitCrit` for all of them) and, if set, fires a bigger `FX.sparks` (9 vs the normal 5) plus an `FX.twinkle` ring, both in `critSpark`'s brighter gold-white tone, then clears the flag — so it can never leak onto a later non-crit hit on the same enemy. A normal (non-crit) hit is completely unchanged from before.

- **`drawStatusEffects(e)`** — draws each status's body-level aura/ring as an independent `if` (freeze ring+fill+glints, fear ring, poison aura+blob, vulnerable pulsing ring), so any combination can render together instead of the old mutually-exclusive priority chain where only one of freeze/stun/charm/fear could show at once. **Phase 12 visual pass (canvas batch)**: freeze/fear rings carry a `shadowBlur` glow in their own status color, and freeze/poison each gained 1-2 small white/dark glint dots so "frozen"/"poisoned" reads as icy/bubbling rather than a flat colored disc. **Slice B clarity pass**: on top of the auras, builds a single stacked-horizontally "status icon row" above the sprite — one small glyph per currently-active status (`☆` stun, `♥` charm, `❄` freeze, `!` fear, `✕` vulnerable; each colored via the matching `Theme.status.*` token, dark-keyline `strokeText` under a colored `fillText`, same idiom `drawFloatTexts` uses), centered as a group and spaced 13px apart, with a slow vertical bob (`Math.sin(this.now/130)`). This replaces the old freeze/fear/vulnerable rings being the *only* feedback for those three (they had no glyph before) and replaces the old hand-drawn vulnerable "X" crosshair with this same icon-row treatment — the vulnerable ring aura itself (`e.radius+4`) is unchanged. Because it's a flat array of active statuses rather than an if/else-if pick, 2+ simultaneous statuses (e.g. Rot & Ruin's Vulnerable + poison) all show their own icon at once. All additions are single extra draw calls per status, not new per-frame allocations — safe at this game's enemy-count scale.

- **`drawBossHealthBar()`** — finds the live boss in `currentRoom.enemies`, draws a top-centered HP bar + name text. Called from `render()` only while `currentRoom.type==='boss' && !cleared`. **Phase 12 visual pass** — was three flat `fillRect`s; now: a glowing backing frame (`shadowBlur` in `Theme.ui.bossBarFill`) plus a thin white keyline border, a lagging "ghost" segment (`this._bossBarGhost`) that eases down toward the real HP fraction over ~2.8s instead of the bar just being instantly shorter next frame — so a big hit reads as a visible red chunk carved out rather than a silent snap — a 3-stop linear-gradient sheen on the live fill instead of one flat color, and a drop-shadowed name label. The ghost state is self-contained (tracks its own frame delta off `this.now`, since `render()` has no `dt` parameter) and resets whenever `this._bossBarBoss` differs from the current boss reference — covers both "entered a new boss room" and "multi-phase fight swapped enemies" — and is also cleared when there's no live boss at all (room cleared / player left), so it can never carry a stale ghost value into a later, unrelated fight. **Batch 3 addition**: under 25% HP the whole frame switches to a harder, faster-pulsing red "bloodied" glow (`shadowBlur`/`strokeStyle` driven by a `this.now`-based sine) instead of the calm default treatment, so a boss on the ropes reads as urgent from the corner of the eye without needing to actually read the bar's fill level. **Slice B clarity pass**: after the live-fill gradient is drawn, adds fixed thin vertical tick marks at 75%/50%/25% of the bar's width (`rgba(0,0,0,.35)`, drawn over the fill) — a purely visual HP-quartile guide, independent of any boss's actual phase thresholds (those remain inline HP-band checks in the AI files, e.g. `ai-4.js`/`ai-stage7-9.js`, and are not stored on the entity or read here).

- ~~`drawPickupPopup()`~~ *(Slice B clarity pass — REMOVED, run-log-gui feature)* — used to draw `game.pickupPopup` as a short-lived name+desc panel on item/familiar pickup. Removed entirely (call site, function body, the `game.pickupPopup` field, its set-on-pickup assignments in `items-2.js`'s `applyItemToPlayer`/`addFamiliar`, and the module-level `PICKUP_POPUP_DURATION` const) and superseded by the always-visible `#logPanel` HUD panel — see "Run log (`game.runLog`/`logEvent`)" below. The pre-existing `toast()` banner and `FloatText` pop that already fired alongside every pickup are untouched and still fire exactly as before.

- ~~`game.pickupPopup`~~ *(Slice B clarity pass — REMOVED, run-log-gui feature)* — see above; fully deleted, no remaining references anywhere in `js/`.

- **Run log (`game.runLog` / `game.logEvent()`)** *(run-log-gui feature, new)* — a scrolling feed of notable per-run events, replacing the removed pickup popup above. `game.runLog` is an array of `{type, label, time}` entries, reset to `[]` in `startRun()` alongside `game.runStats`. `Game.prototype.logEvent(type, label)` (a native class method on `Game`, in `game.js`) pushes `{type, label, time: this.runElapsed}` and caps the array to the most recent 50 entries (`if (this.runLog.length > 50) this.runLog.shift()`). Called from 6 sites: floor completion — `descend()` in `game.js`, at the very top of the function (before any branch-specific logic), `type:'floor'`, label built from `stages.js`'s `floorLabelFor(this.dungeon.floorNum, this.floorPath)` (e.g. `"Floor 7C complete"`); pill usage — `identifyAndApplyPill()` in `pills.js`, `type:'pill'`, label = the pill's color name; familiar obtainment — `addFamiliar()` in `items-2.js`, `type:'familiar'`, label = `familiarDef.name`; item obtainment — `applyItemToPlayer()` in `items-2.js`, `type:'item'`, label = `item.name`; star usage — `useHeldStar()` in `stars.js`, `type:'star'`, label = `STAR_TYPES[starId].name`; trinket pickup — `equipTrinket()` in `items-2.js`, `type:'trinket'`, label = `trinket.name`. Rendered by `ui.js`'s `updateLogPanel(game)` (called from `updateHUD(game)` alongside `updateStatPanel(game)`) into the `#logPanel`/`#logPanelList` DOM panel (`index.html`, `style.css` — mirrors `#statPanel`'s fixed/vertically-centered/desktop-only chrome but anchored to the left edge instead of the right), newest entry first, with `time` formatted as `M:SS`. Gated on `game.runLog.length` via `_hudCache.logLen` rather than a time boundary, since entries only ever get appended.
- **Proximity item tooltip (`updateItemProxTooltip(game)`, `js/ui/ui.js`)** — a mode-agnostic HUD readout of whatever purchasable/pickable item the player is standing next to. Called from `updateHUD(game)` right after `updateLogPanel(game)`. Each call it scans `game.currentRoom.shopSlots` (via `itemProxThingFromSlot(slot)`, which resolves only unbought `item`/`trinket`/`familiar` slots — pickup/coin slots are ignored) and `game.currentRoom.itemPedestals` (any untaken pedestal, covering treasure, shrine, devil-deal and pet-shop pedestals, whose `.item` field holds the item/familiar def), keeping the single nearest source within `ITEM_PROX_RADIUS` (70px) of `game.player`, measured `Util.dist(player.x, player.y, tile.x * TILE, tile.y * TILE)`. It writes the def's `icon`+`name` into `.hudPanelName` and its `desc` (omitted when absent) into `.hudPanelDesc` inside `#itemProxTooltip`/`#itemProxTooltipBody` (`index.html`, `style.css` — a `.hudPanel` fixed at bottom-centre, `pointer-events:none`), toggling `.hud-panel-hidden` when nothing is nearby. Caching follows `updateLogPanel`'s pattern: `_hudCache.proxItem` holds the shown def's `id`/`name` (or `null`), and an unchanged key early-returns before any `innerHTML` write. Deliberately **not** gated on `game.mode`, so it works in story shops, treasure rooms, shrines and the wave-defense shop alike.

- **`drawProjectiles()`** — draws each `this.projectiles` entry as a glowing disc with a glint highlight.

- **`drawBombsExplosions()`** — draws each `this.bombs` (pulsing body + fuse spark, hot fuse color under 0.5s) and each `this.explosions` (expanding radial-gradient blast + ring, driven by `ex.life/maxLife`).

- **`drawGreenFireZone()`** — draws the Changeling's held green-fire pool (`player.fireZone`) as a radial gradient with animated licking-flame dots around the rim; purely cosmetic, draws nothing when `fireZone` is null.

- **`drawSwingFX()`** — draws the melee swing arc (`this.swingFX`) as two fading trail arcs.

- **`drawLaserFX()`** — draws a beam (`this.laserFX`), shared by Pony Bot's laser and Dragon's fire breath; `fx.color`/`fx.width` let the caller reskin it (default cyan).

- **`drawFloatTexts()`** — draws each `this.floatTexts` entry as fading text. **Phase 12 visual pass (canvas batch)** — every entry now gets a `strokeText` dark keyline (`Theme.shadow.outline`, `lineWidth`/`strokeStyle` set once outside the loop) before its `fillText`, the same small-text legibility convention used everywhere else in the game — damage numbers/"CRIT"/pickup labels stay readable over any floor palette instead of relying on the text's own (sometimes light) color alone. **Damage numbers toggle (Slice A QOL)** — skips drawing (`continue`s the loop, still lets `systems/combat-4.js`'s lifecycle update age/expire it normally) any entry where `f.isDamage && !damageNumbersEnabled`; see the damage numbers toggle writeup in the `ui/settings.js` section.

---

### ui/ui.js

HUD, minimap, toasts, and the main-menu class-select/trophy panels.

- **`roomTypeColor(type)`** — room-type → hex color lookup, used by minimap drawing. Phase 6a overhaul: added `shrine` (`#d4af37`, matching `votivecoin`'s icon color) and `arcade` (`#c93f6b`, matching `Theme.door.arcade`'s `open` color) — both were previously falling through to the generic `default: '#8b86a8'` on the minimap. Phase 7a: added `planetarium` (`#6a5ce0`, matching `Theme.door.planetarium`'s `open` color). **Secret Room Revamp Slice 3**: added `supersecret` (`#7a3fd6`, a darker/deeper violet than `secret`'s `#c9a3ff`, so the two read apart at a glance once both are discovered). **Karma/Minimap fix**: added `mirror` (`#a8c3d4`, pale icy blue), `karma` (`#c9d15e`, yellow-green), `bosschallenge` (`#ff3860`, bright crimson) — none of these three colliding with any existing entry.
- **`ROOM_TYPE_ICON`** — room-type → emoji lookup, used by minimap icons and (indirectly) `toggleMinimapLegend`. Phase 6a overhaul: added `shrine: '🕯️'` / `arcade: '🎰'`, matching the icons already used for these two types in `data/economy.js`'s `ROOM_TYPE_LIST`. Phase 7a: added `planetarium: '🔭'`, same rule. **Secret Room Revamp Slice 3**: added `supersecret: '💠'`, distinct from `secret`'s `❓`. **Karma/Minimap fix**: added `mirror: '🪞'`, `karma: '🙏'`, `bosschallenge: '👹'`.
- **`ROOM_TYPE_LEGEND`** — room-type → friendly label text, for the legend popup. Phase 6a overhaul: added `shrine`/`arcade` entries (both were missing, same gap as the two lookups above). Phase 7a: added `planetarium` ("Planetarium (floor 3 only — takes the D-branch)"), keeping all three lookups in sync. **Secret Room Revamp Slice 3**: added `supersecret: 'Super Secret Room'`. **Floor Generation Revamp Slice 4**: `attachSuperSecretRoom` is now wired into `generateDungeon`, so this room type is reachable in a real game and these lookup entries are live/used in practice; visibility pre-discovery needs no special-case code of its own since ui.js's `knowsExistence`/`knowsType` gates (line ~706-707) are already generic across every room type, `secret` included. **Karma/Minimap fix**: added `mirror: 'Mirror Room (mirror boss)'`, `karma: 'Karma Room (resource donation)'`, `bosschallenge: 'Boss Challenge Room'` — these three room types (`systems/dungeon.js`) previously fell through to the generic default color/no-icon/`'Room'` label on the minimap.
- **`toggleMinimapLegend()`** — builds/toggles the `#minimapLegend` popup listing every `ROOM_TYPE_LEGEND` entry plus the "pulsing ring" hint. Called from main.js's `minimapLegendBtn` click handler.
- **`roomCentroidBlock(node)`** — average block position of a room's mask (for placing one icon per room regardless of shape/size). Returns `{bx,by}`.
- **`roomLootEntries(node)`** — collects all uncollected loot (pedestal items, pickups, unopened chests) in a room into a flat array of `{kind, ...}` descriptors, for minimap loot markers.
- **`drawLootEntry(ctx,entry,x,y)`** — draws one loot entry via the matching `Util.draw*Icon` function.
- **`drawLootMarkers(ctx,entries,cx,cy)`** — draws up to a 3-column grid of loot icons (scaled 0.4x) centered on `(cx,cy)`. Called by `drawMinimap`.
- **`_hudCache`** — dirty-check cache object (`hearts/coins/keys/bombs/leftPanel/familiars`, plus — Phase 6a overhaul — `turrets`/`minions`/`synergy`) so `updateHUD` can skip redundant DOM/canvas writes on unchanged frames.
- **`SYNERGY_BADGES`** (Phase 6a overhaul) — array of `{id, flag}` pairs mapping each `#synergyBar` badge span id (`synEcosystem`/`synRotRuin`/`synMarksman`/`synPackBond`/`synTwinFangs`) to the `player.<flag>Active` boolean `updateHUD` reads for it (`ecosystemSetActive`/`rotAndRuinActive`/`marksmansEyeActive`/`packBondActive`/`twinFangsActive`, all set in `systems/items-1.js`'s `recalcPlayerStats`). Lets `updateHUD` loop over the 5 badges instead of repeating the same toggle by hand.
- **`hudPanelEntry(label, thing)`** — builds one "Name — description" HTML block (or "None") for the left HUD panel; `thing` is any `{name,desc,icon}`-shaped object (item/trinket/star).
- **`hudPillReadout(game)`** — builds the pill-identification HTML list: identified colors show their real effect, unidentified ones collapse into a single "??? — N unknown" line. Reads `game.pillIdentified`/`game.pillEffectMap`.
- **`updateHUD(game)`** — the main per-tick HUD sync function (called every frame from `Game.prototype.update`, including its early-return freeze/hit-stop paths). Lazily creates `#heartsCanvas`; redraws the hearts strip (via `Util.drawHeart`) only when the dirty-check key changes (handles fractional red pips, the Eternal Heart's pale trailing pip, and blue pips); toggles `.low-health` vignette class; updates `#resCoins`/`#resKeys`/`#resBombs`/`#resFloor` text (with `∞` for unlimited-floor flags); updates the active-item icon+charge pips (`#activeItemIcon`/`#activeItemPips`, `.ready-glow` when full); updates the trinket/pill/star HUD icons; updates the speed/rate/damage/luck/range stat readouts (`#statSpeed` etc, laser/unlimitedRange show `∞`); rebuilds `#passivesBar` chips every call (one per owned passive, count in the title); rebuilds `#familiarBar` chips only on change (tallies `player.familiars` by `def.id`, shows a count badge for duplicates); rebuilds the left side panel (`#leftPanelActive/Trinket/Star/Pills`) only on change via `hudPanelEntry`/`hudPillReadout`. Phase 6a overhaul: toggles `#resTurrets`/`#resMinions`'s shared `.hidden` utility class based on `player.canBuildTurrets`/`player.summonsChangelings` (only Engineer Pony/Changeling Queen ever see them), and when shown, sets dirty-checked text `(game.currentRoom.playerTurrets||[]).length + '/3'` / `(player.changelingMinions||[]).length + '/' + player.maxChangelingMinions`; also loops `SYNERGY_BADGES` to toggle each `#synergyBar` span's `.active` class off `player[flag]`, dirty-checked as one joined `'1'/'0'` key string (same shape as the familiar bank's `famKey`). Reads/writes many `#`-ids in index.html and reads `game.player`, `game.dungeon.floorNum`, `game.floorPath`, `game.pillIdentified`, `game.pillEffectMap`. Slice D2: also calls `updateStatPanel(game)` as its last step.

- **`updateStatPanel(game)`** (Slice D2, reworked in a later QOL pass) — populates `#statPanelBody`, the live build/deal stat-sheet shown in the desktop-only `#statPanel` (a sibling of `#canvasWrap`, `position:fixed` against the viewport's right edge like `.side-action-bar`'s left-edge equivalent, gated behind `@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) and (min-width:1500px)` in style.css — hidden outright below that width, no mobile fallback strip since this is a bonus readout rather than load-bearing HUD). Throttled to once per elapsed-second: bails immediately if `Math.floor(game.runElapsed)` matches `_hudCache.statSec` (the same dirty-check object `updateHUD` uses for the hearts strip etc), so it's a no-op on ~59 of every 60 frames. Deliberately reads live `game.player` fields rather than `game.runStats` — this panel shows the current build's stats, not run-accumulated counters. Three `.statSectionHead`-labeled sections (styled in style.css, a bordered uppercase divider row reusing `.statRow`'s container): **Main Stats** — Damage (`meleeDamage`/`rangedDamage` per `attackType`), Speed, Range (`rangeTiles`), Fire Rate (`1/cooldown` off `meleeCooldown`/`fireCooldown`, `.toFixed(1)` + `/s`), Luck; **Chance Stats** — Crit/Lifesteal/Freeze/Venom/Stun/Charm/Fear %, each `Math.round(chance*100)+'%'` straight off the matching `player.*Chance` field; **Deals** — Alignment (`game.dealAlignment`, `'Unset'` until the first deal is taken) and Deal Chance (mirrors `dungeon.js`'s actual spawn roll exactly: 0% once `player.dealFreebieUsed`, else 16% if `player.tookDamageThisFloor` else 50% — see `js/systems/dungeon.js` ~line 704-707, kept in sync deliberately so the readout never drifts from the real roll). Called from the tail of `updateHUD(game)`.
- **`minimapCacheKey(game)`** — builds a string key from `currentRoom.id`, `player.revealMap`, and every room's discovered/revealed/seen state, used to detect when the minimap's baked layer needs a rebuild.
- **`drawMinimap(game)`** — draws the minimap onto `#minimap`. Bakes the static half (door-connection lines + per-block room-footprint squares) to an offscreen canvas (`_mmCanvas`, module-level cache keyed by `_mmDungeon`/`_mmKey`) and blits it, then draws the animated parts live every call: a pulsing "you are here" ring on the current room's blocks, a room-type icon per room (as soon as its existence is known — `knowsExistence`), and loot markers (`drawLootMarkers`) on discovered rooms. Reads `game.dungeon.rooms`, `game.currentRoom`, `game.player.revealMap`, `game.now`. Called every `update()` tick from game.js.
- **`toast(msg, long, kind)`** / **`advanceToastQueue()`** — a queued (not clobbered) toast system; `long` extends on-screen time for achievement-unlock toasts. Called from many files across the codebase (game.js, main.js, combat/items/shop/etc — grep confirms wide usage). **Phase 12 visual pass** — optional 3rd arg `kind` (`'good'|'bad'|'info'`) adds a `toast-<kind>` class (style.css: a colored left-accent border + matching glow, omitted entirely for an untagged call — the original plain look) so a toast can read as "this happened TO you" at a glance. Wired at 4 call sites so far: achievement unlock + class unlock (`'good'`, `achievements/logic.js`), personal-best floor (`'good'`, `game.js`), first-ever bestiary discovery (`'info'`, `combat-2.js`) — every other existing `toast()`/`game.toast()` call across the codebase is untouched and keeps its original neutral look.
- **`showRoomBanner(text, roomType)`** (ui.js) — **Phase 12 visual pass**: also prefixes the room's `ROOM_TYPE_ICON` glyph (the same one the minimap uses) onto the banner text when `roomType` is given and has an icon; room types with no icon (normal, gate rooms, arcade) render exactly as before.
- **Synergy badges "just activated" flash** (ui.js's `updateHUD`, style.css's `.synergy-badge.just-activated`) — **Phase 12 visual pass**. The existing `synKey` dirty-check only detected "something about the joined synergy state changed"; it's now compared per-badge against the PREVIOUS key so only a badge that just flipped from inactive to active (not one that was already lit) gets a one-shot bright ring-burst animation, force-restarted via remove+reflow+re-add (`classList.add` alone is a no-op if the class already lingers from a rapid double-toggle).
- **`showRoomBanner(text, roomType)`** — shows the `#roomBanner` room-name banner for 1.6s. `roomType` is optional (Phase 12 visual pass): when given, sets the `--banner-color` CSS custom property to `roomTypeColor(roomType)` (the same lookup the minimap uses) inline on the element, so a boss room's banner glows red, a shop's violet, etc., instead of every room type sharing the original flat gold; an empty/omitted `roomType` cleanly falls back to gold via CSS's `var(--banner-color, var(--gold))` (an empty custom property is invalid-at-computed-value-time for `color`, which is exactly what triggers a `var()` fallback). Called by game.js's `enterRoom` as `showRoomBanner(label, node.type)`.
- **`showItemExamine(ped)`** — shows/hides the `#itemExamine` tooltip for a nearby pedestal (item/trinket/familiar all share the same pedestal shape). Called by game.js's `updateItemExamine`.
- **`buildClassSelect(onPick)`** — builds the `#classSelect` card grid: each unlocked class gets a drawn pony preview (`Util.drawPony`) and its real name/desc/click-to-pick handler; locked classes show a "?" placeholder, `???`, and live unlock progress (reading the matching `ACHIEVEMENTS` entry's `statKey`/`threshold`) plus a deny-sound click handler. Called from main.js on load and from `returnToMenu()`. **Slice E — compact stat block.** Unlocked cards only get a `.class-card-stats` block (`.statRow`s, same markup pattern as Slice D2's `#statPanel`) between the description and the superboss-routes row, showing base HP (`redMax`), Speed, Damage (`meleeDamage`/`rangedDamage` per `attackType`), Rate/s (`(1/cooldown).toFixed(1)` off `meleeCooldown`/`fireCooldown`), and Range (`baseRangeTiles`) — straight off the `CLASSES` def, not live per-run state. Each row is field-presence-gated: any field that's falsy/0 on that class (e.g. `redMax:0` for Pony Bot, `baseRangeTiles` absent on most classes) just skips its row instead of rendering a wrong/blank value. Locked cards render no stat block.
  - **Phase 10 — per-route superboss indicator.** Every UNLOCKED card additionally gets a `.class-superboss-routes` footer row of three small pill badges, one per `SUPERBOSS_ROUTE_ORDER` entry (`data/enemies/superboss-routes.js`: `'main'` labelled "A/B" — the original linear route plus its internal 9A/9B..12A/12B branch-within-a-branch, both sides counted together since they're mutually exclusive within one run but both still "the main route" — `'C'`, `'D'`), each reading `"<label> <beaten>/<total>"` for superbosses THAT CLASS has personally killed. Counts come from `unlocks.classSuperbossDefeats[classId][superbossId]` (new in `game.js`'s `onBossDefeated`, written right alongside — but as a genuinely separate structure from — the older global `unlocks.superbossDefeats[superbossId]` counter `buildSuperbossTrophies` below already reads; the global counter has no per-class dimension, so it couldn't answer "which of MY runs on THIS character beat this boss"). A badge's `title` lists every superboss in that route with a ✓/· prefix, **in the order the player actually encounters them** (ascending floorNum) via the new `SUPERBOSS_ROUTE_SEQUENCE` export — deliberately NOT `SUPERBOSS_LIST.filter(...)`'s raw object-insertion order, which gets two spots wrong: `onetruednb` (floorNum 14) is declared before `wobbler`/`subdrop` (floorNum 12/13) in `superbosses.js`, and `kirk` (floorNum 11, the C-branch finale as of Phase 7a) is declared before `monsoon`/`mangrove` (floorNum 9/10) for the same reason — both appended to the object literal in write-order, not encounter-order. `SUPERBOSS_ROUTE_SEQUENCE[route]` is a hand-verified array of ids in floorNum order (branch-pair bosses sharing one floorNum, e.g. `pineapple`/`israel` at 8, listed branch-A-then-B); a data-level test confirms its id set exactly matches `SUPERBOSS_ROUTE`'s per-route membership for all 32 current superbosses, so the two structures can't silently drift apart. Badge gets `.has-progress` (subtle purple) once `beaten>0`, `.complete` (gold glow) once the whole route is cleared by that class. `data/enemies/superboss-routes.js` also exports `SUPERBOSS_ROUTE` (`{id: 'main'|'C'|'D'}`, all 32 current superbosses, verified exhaustive) and `SUPERBOSS_ROUTE_LABELS`; loaded after every file that defines a `SUPERBOSSES` entry (`superbosses.js`, then the three Phase 10 `stageN-M-superbosses.js` files) since none of this is derivable from the superboss data itself — a superboss is tied to a floorNum/route by a hardcoded dispatch in `game.js`'s `descend()`, not by a data field.
- **`buildSuperbossTrophies()`** — builds the global `#trophyRow` at the bottom of the main menu (`<h2 class="trophyTitle">Superbosses</h2>`) showing beaten bosses' icon/name/defeat-count and `❓`/`???` for undefeated ones. **Phase 10 — route split.** Rewritten to group the trophies into three `.trophy-route-group` sections (one per `SUPERBOSS_ROUTE_ORDER` entry, headed by a `.trophy-route-label` reading `"<label> route"`) instead of one flat row — `index.html`'s `#trophyRow` div changed class from `.trophy-row` to `.trophy-routes` (the new outer flex-column container; each group still holds its own inner `.trophy-row`). Each group's bosses come from `SUPERBOSS_ROUTE_SEQUENCE[route].map(id => SUPERBOSSES[id])` — the same hand-verified encounter-order array `buildClassSelect`'s per-route indicator uses (see that entry above) — rather than filtering `SUPERBOSS_LIST` directly, so both UI surfaces share one correctly-ordered source of truth instead of each re-deriving (or mis-deriving) the order. Reads the pre-existing global `unlocks.superbossDefeats` (not the per-class `classSuperbossDefeats` `buildClassSelect` uses) since this row is account-wide, not per-character. Called from main.js on load and `returnToMenu()`.

---

### ui/roomEditor.js

Standalone logic for `room-editor.html` (a separate tool page, not part of the live game's script set, but shares game code like `buildRoomTiles`/`decodeSpawner`/`computeDoorSlots` from room.js/dungeon.js so its previews and exported data are guaranteed to match runtime behavior).

**State**: `TILE_PX` (editor zoom level), `CATEGORY_COLORS`, `workingMask` (4x4 block grid), `spawnerMap` (Map of `"x,y"`→spawner), `selectedCategory`, `selectedSubGroup`/`selectedStage`/`selectedEnemyPath` (tabbed-palette state, see below; `selectedEnemyPath` is `'main'`|`'C'`|`'D'` and is browsing-only — it is unrelated to `selectedFloorPath`, which decides the exported template's path restriction), `recentTools` (per-category recently-placed-tool ring buffers, max 5 each), `lastOpts` (the most recently built `#specificSelect` options array, kept for the filter box to re-render from), `currentGrid`/`gridW`/`gridH` (built tile grid), `disabledDoorSlots` (Set of `"col,row,dir"`), `previewDoorSlots`, `floorState`/`cFloorState`/`dFloorState` (per-path floor allow arrays — main/C/D respectively, `cFloorState` indexed 2..`C_LAST_FLOORNUM`, `dFloorState` indexed 3..`D_LAST_FLOORNUM`, all default all-true) plus `selectedFloorPath` (`'main'`|`'C'`|`'D'`, which array/tab is currently shown), `hoverTile`.

**Tabbed placement palette** (category → subgroup → stage, on top of the flat category buttons):
- `PICKUP_SUBGROUPS` (Coins/Hearts/Keys-Bombs/Pills/Stars/Chests/Other) and `PICKUP_SUBGROUP_MATCH` (substring predicates used to bucket `PICKUP_TYPE_LIST` entries into Hearts/Keys-Bombs/Other).
- `stageIdsFor(registry)` / `allStageIds()` — collect the distinct numeric `stage` values present across `ENEMY_TYPES`/`BOSS_TYPES` (14 stages, 0-13); `SUPERBOSSES` entries carry no `stage` field, so superbosses only ever show up in the all-stages ("Random") Bosses view.
- `floorKeysFor(registry, suffix)` — collects the distinct `.floorKey` strings (e.g. `'13C'`, `'4D'`) ending in the given single-letter path suffix from one registry, sorted ascending by numeric prefix. Branch-path enemies/bosses use `.floorKey` instead of the main path's numeric `.stage`.
- `renderEnemyPathButtons()` — renders a Main/C-Path/D-Path button row into `#enemyPathBtns` (same `.row.catbtns`/`button.active` pattern as `renderFloorPathButtons()`), shown only while `selectedCategory === 'enemy'` and hidden otherwise. Clicking sets `selectedEnemyPath`, resets `selectedStage` to `'random'`, and re-renders the path row, the stage row and the specific-select. Called from `renderSubTabs()` (so it is covered by init, category switches and recent-tool restores).
- `renderSubTabs()` — populates/shows `#subGroupBtns`/`#subStageBtns` based on `selectedCategory`: for `enemy`, subgroup row is Enemies/Bosses and stage row is "Random" + one button per stage (or, when `selectedEnemyPath` is `'C'`/`'D'`, one button per floorKey found in the *currently selected subgroup's own registry* — `ENEMY_TYPES` or `BOSS_TYPES`, not their union — labelled "Stage 13C", so a boss-less floor never shows an empty boss tab); for `pickup`, subgroup row is the `PICKUP_SUBGROUPS` list with no stage row; every other category hides both rows (flat behavior unchanged).
- `resetSubGroupDefaults()` — resets `selectedSubGroup`/`selectedStage` to sensible defaults whenever `selectedCategory` changes; called from both the category-button click handler and the `1`-`7` keyboard shortcuts, alongside `renderSubTabs()`.
- Tab/Shift+Tab keyboard cycling — the module-level `keydown` handler finds whichever of `#subGroupBtns`/`#subStageBtns` is visible and non-empty (preferring the row holding the currently-active button) and clicks the next/previous button in it with wraparound, reusing each button's own click listener rather than duplicating state logic. Skipped while a TEXTAREA/INPUT/SELECT has focus, so typing in `#paletteFilter` doesn't trigger it.
- `#paletteFilter` + `renderFilteredOptions()` — a text input above `#specificSelect`; `populateSpecificSelect()` stores its built options array into `lastOpts` instead of rendering directly, and `renderFilteredOptions()` renders `<option>`s from `lastOpts` filtered by a case-insensitive substring match against `label`/`value` (preserving the current selection when it survives the filter), also setting each `<option>`'s `title` attribute to its label as a native hover tooltip. Wired to `#paletteFilter`'s `input` event.
- `recordRecentTool(tool)` / `renderRecentTools()` — `recordRecentTool` is called from `paintAt()` on every successful non-erase placement; it reads the just-placed `#specificSelect` option's label, builds `{category, subGroup, stage, enemyPath, value, label}` (`enemyPath` defaults to `'main'` on restore, for entries stored before the field existed), de-dupes by `value`+`subGroup` within that category's list, unshifts, caps at 5. `renderRecentTools()` renders (or hides) buttons into `#recentToolBtns` for the active category's list; clicking one restores the saved category/subgroup/stage/value and preview. Called both after a placement and from `populateSpecificSelect()` (so the row always reflects the active category).

**Mask/shape editing**
- `makeEmptyMask()` — fresh 4x4 zero grid.
- `isMaskConnected(mask)` — flood-fill connectivity check.
- `trimMaskWithOffset(mask)` — trims a mask to its bounding box, returns `{mask, offR, offC}` (used on export).
- `renderBlockGrid()` — draws the 4x4 block-toggle UI, shows block count + connectivity warnings; click handler pushes undo and toggles a block, then `rebuildGrid()`.
- `rebuildGrid()` — rebuilds `currentGrid`/`gridW`/`gridH` from `workingMask` via `buildPreviewDoorSlots` + `buildRoomTiles` (shared with the real game), or shows a placeholder if no blocks are set. Calls `renderCanvas()`/`updateStatsAndWarnings()`.
- `disabledDoorsField(offC,offR,mask)` — converts the flat `disabledDoorSlots` Set into the per-block `[col,row,dirLetters]` format the exporter/`computeDoorSlots` expect, dropping stale entries outside `mask`.
- `buildPreviewDoorSlots(mask, doorField)` — calls the shared `computeDoorSlots`, marking non-disabled slots `type:'normal'`.
- `doorMarkerCenter(slot)` / `findDoorSlotAtEvent(e)` / `toggleDoorSlot(slot)` — hit-testing and toggling of door markers drawn on the canvas (click a marker to enable/disable a door on that block edge).

**Spawner placement**
- `OBSTACLE_GLYPHS` — obstacle-kind → single-char glyph map for the plain (non-preview) render fallback.
- `spawnerGlyph(sp)` — resolves a spawner's fallback glyph.
- `renderCanvas()` — full canvas redraw: tiles (void/wall/door/floor coloring), grid lines, door markers (green=open/red=disabled), placed spawners (real preview via `toolPreviewDef`+`drawPreviewAt` for forced spawners, else a colored square+glyph), and a hover preview of the current tool.
- `canvasToTile(e)` / `currentTool()` — pointer→tile coords; resolves the active category+select-value into a `{category,kind,specific?}` tool descriptor (`kind` is `'generic'`, `'genericBoss'`, `'genericSuperboss'`, or `'forced'`).
- `toolPreviewDef(tool)` — normalizes a forced tool selection into a `{renderKind,...}` descriptor (enemy/pickup/chest/item/obstacle) for real rendering, reusing `ENEMY_TYPES`/`BOSS_TYPES`/`SUPERBOSSES`/`ITEMS`/`TRINKETS`/`FAMILIAR_TYPES`/`OBSTACLES` lookups.
- `fakePickupFor(kindStr)` — builds a minimal Pickup-shaped object for `Util.drawPickupIcon` preview purposes.
- `drawPreviewAt(ctx,x,y,pv,sizeHint)` — dispatches a `toolPreviewDef` descriptor to the matching real `Util.draw*` function, sized to fit the given canvas.
- `previewDescFor(pv)` / `updateToolPreviewCard()` — builds and renders the small "what you're about to place" preview card (`#toolPreviewCanvas`/Name/Desc).
- Drag-to-paint: `paintAt(x,y,erasing)` (places/erases a spawner on a floor tile, pushes one undo per drag gesture not per tile), plus `mousedown`/`mouseup`/`mousemove`/`mouseleave`/`contextmenu` listeners on `#editorCanvas` wiring door-click, paint, and erase (right-click-drag) behavior.

**Stats/warnings**
- `updateStatsAndWarnings()` — updates the `#statsReadout` counts and a room-type-specific `#roomWarning` message (e.g. "no enemy spawner", "no boss spawner", auto-added-fixture notices for petshop/sacrifice/challenge, hand-design notices for curse/vault/crystal/sombra). Also prefixes a path-mismatch warning from `pathMismatchWarning()` when one applies. Re-run on every floor-toggle click so the mismatch check stays live.
- `restrictionFlags()` / `exportedPathRestriction()` — `restrictionFlags()` returns `{main, c, d}` booleans for "this path's floor toggles are partially off"; `exportTemplate()` and the warning both read it, so the warning can never disagree with what is actually exported. `exportedPathRestriction()` collapses those flags into the `'C'`/`'D'` value that would be emitted as `template.p` (or `null` when main-restriction wins or nothing is restricted).
- `pathMismatchWarning()` — when the room would export `p:'C'`/`p:'D'`, scans `spawnerMap` for forced enemy/boss spawners whose `ENEMY_TYPES`/`BOSS_TYPES`/`SUPERBOSSES` def has a `.floorKey` of the *other* branch path, and returns a message naming them ("… is an enemy from another path, but this room is restricted to the C-path — they will never spawn here."). Returns `''` when the room carries no path restriction, since a `p`-less template is allowed on every path.

**Tool palette**
- `populateSpecificSelect()` — rebuilds `#specificSelect`'s options for the selected category+subgroup+stage (all data-driven, no hardcoded id lists): enemy branch first checks `selectedEnemyPath`: on `'C'`/`'D'` it lists branch enemies/bosses filtered by `.floorKey` (all keys of that path when `selectedStage === 'random'`, else the exact floorKey), reusing the existing `'generic'`/`'generic-boss'`/`'generic-superboss'` catch-all values so nothing new enters the spawner wire format; on `'main'` it splits into Enemies (registry-filtered `ENEMY_TYPES` by `selectedStage`, "Random (all/this stage)" pinned top) and Bosses (`BOSS_TYPES` filtered by `selectedStage`, "Random Boss (this floor/stage)" pinned top, and — only in the all-stages "Random" view, since superbosses carry no `stage` — "Random Superboss" plus every individual `SUPERBOSSES` entry); pickup branch pulls from `COIN_TYPES`/`PICKUP_TYPE_LIST`/`PILL_COLORS`/`STAR_LIST`/`CHEST_TYPES` bucketed by `PICKUP_SUBGROUPS`, with a universal "Random (any pickup)" pinned top; item/deal/shop/obstacle lists unchanged (`ITEM_LIST`/`pools.includes('sombra')`/items+trinkets+familiars+priced pickups/`OBSTACLES`). Resets and re-shows `#paletteFilter`, stores the built list into `lastOpts`, delegates actual `<option>` rendering to `renderFilteredOptions()`, and calls `renderRecentTools()`.
- Category/zoom button click wiring (`categoryBtns`, `zoomBtns`).
- `renderFloorPathButtons()` — the Main/C-Path/D-Path tab row (`#floorPathBtns`, reuses the `.catbtns`/`button.active` styling), switches `selectedFloorPath` and re-renders `#floorBtns`.
- `renderFloorButtons()` — per-floor allow/disallow toggle buttons for whichever path is active, labeled via `floorLabelFor(floorNum, path)` (C/D buttons also get a `floorNameFor` tooltip); toggles the matching one of `floorState`/`cFloorState`/`dFloorState`.

**Undo/redo**
- `snapshotState()` / `restoreState(snap)` / `pushUndo()` / `undo()` / `redo()` / `updateUndoRedoButtons()` — full-state (mask+spawners+disabled doors+all three floor-path states+`selectedFloorPath`+room type) undo stack, capped at `MAX_UNDO=80`. Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y keybindings wired at module scope (skipped while typing in a text field).

**Reset buttons**: `#resetSpawnersBtn` (clears `spawnerMap` only) and `#resetAllBtn` (clears everything back to a single default block).

**Import**: `#importBtn` handler parses a pasted `ROOM_TEMPLATES.<type>.push({...})` line (or bare JSON) via regex + `JSON.parse`, validates it has a mask (`obj.m`), then loads `workingMask`/`spawnerMap` (via room.js's shared `decodeSpawner` — not locally defined here, so it already understands `genericSuperboss`'s `'S'` code with zero editor-side changes)/`disabledDoorSlots` (handles both the legacy room-wide door-direction-string format and the new per-block array format) from it, and sets the Type dropdown if detectable. Floor-path-aware: branches on `obj.p` — absent means `obj.f` applies to `floorState` (main) and `selectedFloorPath` resets to `'main'`; `'C'`/`'D'` apply `obj.f` onto `cFloorState`/`dFloorState` (raw floorNums) and switch `selectedFloorPath` to match; the two arrays not targeted are reset to all-true. Re-renders `#floorPathBtns`/`#floorBtns` after loading so the visible tab matches the imported data.

**Export** — `exportTemplate()`, the function that generates `ROOM_TEMPLATES.<type>.push(...)` text: trims the mask (`trimMaskWithOffset`), warns on >4 blocks / disconnected blocks, rebuilds the door field and tile grid for the trimmed shape, remaps every spawner's coordinates into the trimmed offset (dropping — with a count in the hint — any spawner that lands outside the trimmed floor), encodes each surviving spawner via `encodeSpawner`, and assembles `{m, s?, f?, d?, p?}` into `'ROOM_TEMPLATES.' + roomType + '.push(' + JSON.stringify(template) + ');'`, written to `#exportArea`. Path restriction: if `floorState` (main) has any disabled floor, `f` is its true-index list as before with no `p`; else if `cFloorState`/`dFloorState` has any disabled floor (within its valid range), `p` is set to `'C'`/`'D'` and `f` is that array's true floorNums — main takes priority if somehow more than one path is restricted at once.
- **`SPAWNER_CATEGORY_ENCODE`** = `{enemy:'e', pickup:'p', item:'i', deal:'d', shop:'s', obstacle:'o'}` — the one-letter category codes used in the exported/compact spawner format (`[x,y,category,kind,specific?]`, where `kind` is further compacted to `'g'`=generic, `'b'`=genericBoss, `'S'`=genericSuperboss, `'f'`=forced with an explicit `specific` value; obstacles always encode as `['o', specific]` since they have no generic/boss/superboss variant). The `'S'` code matches room.js's `decodeSpawner`/`instantiateSpawner` exactly, which already resolved a `genericSuperboss` kind via `resolveGenericSuperboss()` before this tool exposed it in the UI.
- `encodeSpawner(sp)` — applies the above encoding to one spawner.
- `#copyBtn` handler — copies `#exportArea`'s text to the clipboard (generating it first if empty), via both `document.execCommand('copy')` and `navigator.clipboard.writeText`.
- `#duplicateVariantBtn` handler — generates export text via `exportTemplate()` if `#exportArea` is empty, then builds a `.variant` block (heading + Copy button + readonly textarea holding that export string) and prepends it into `#variantList`; does not touch `spawnerMap`/`workingMask`/`currentGrid`/the live canvas/undo stack, so the working room is unaffected — purely a way to snapshot multiple export variants side by side.
- `testInGame()` (wired to `#testInGameBtn`, Pass B) — reuses `exportTemplate()`'s output (generating it first if empty), writes it verbatim to `localStorage['adele2_testRoom']`, then navigates via `window.location.href = 'index.html'` to the live game, which picks the pending room up on load (see main.js's `tryBootTestRoom()` and game.js's `loadTestRoom()` below).
- Batch file buffer (Pass C) — module-scope `batchLines` array, restored on load from `localStorage['adele2_roomEditorBatch']` (JSON, try/catch, falls back to `[]`); `renderFileBufferArea()` writes it (one export line per entry, newline-joined) into the readonly `#fileBufferArea` textarea. `#addToFileBtn` generates via `exportTemplate()` if `#exportArea` is empty, pushes its value onto `batchLines`, persists to `localStorage`, and re-renders the buffer. `#copyFileBtn` copies `#fileBufferArea`'s value using the same `execCommand('copy')` + `navigator.clipboard.writeText` combo as `#copyBtn`, or sets an `#exportHint` message if the buffer is empty. `#clearFileBtn` prompts via `window.confirm()`, then resets `batchLines` and the localStorage key and re-renders.

Init block at the bottom calls `renderFloorPathButtons()`, `renderFloorButtons()`, `renderBlockGrid()`, `rebuildGrid()`, `populateSpecificSelect()`, `updateUndoRedoButtons()`, `updateStatsAndWarnings()`, `renderFileBufferArea()` to set up the initial page state.

### main.js

Bootstrap: persistence helpers, global input state + event wiring, pause/overlay screens, difficulty selection, fullscreen/wake-lock/visibility handling, the main-menu/end-screen flow, and the `requestAnimationFrame` game loop.

**Persistence**
- **`loadUnlocks()`** — `JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nightfallUnlocks') || '{}')`, try/catch returns `{}` on error. The single source-of-truth read for all cross-run unlock/stat/bestiary state (shape defined/normalized by achievements.js's `ensureUnlockShape`). Called extremely widely across the codebase (game.js, ui.js, achievements.js, combat/items/etc).
- **`saveUnlocks(u)`** — `localStorage.setItem('nightfallUnlocks', JSON.stringify(u))`.
- localStorage keys used directly in this file: `nightfallUnlocks` (main save blob), `nightfallAchvSeenCount`, `nightfallDifficulty`, `nightfallBestiaryTab` (read in bestiary.js but the same storage namespace).

**Global state**: `game` (the live `Game` instance or `null`), `input` (`{left,right,up,down,attack,mouseX,mouseY,mouseActive}`), `canvas` (`#game` element reference).

**Input wiring**
- `toggleMuteUI()` — toggles `Sound`'s mute state, syncs the mute button, toasts.
- `keydown` listener on `window` — WASD/arrows → `input.*`, Space→`attack`, B/E/Q/R/F/G/H → `game.tryPlaceBomb/tryUseActive/tryUsePill/tryUseStar/tryDonate/tryReroll/tryArcadeInteract` (G and H are both guarded against key-repeat so holding them doesn't drain coins/bombs/keys/hearts), M→`toggleMuteUI`, T→bestiary-style toggle of the Achievements overlay, C→toggle the Bestiary overlay, K→toggle the Skill Tree overlay (Phase 8b), Escape→closes an open overlay if any, else `togglePause()`. Also calls `Sound.unlock()` on every keydown (first real user gesture).
- `keyup` listener — clears the WASD/arrow/attack flags.
- **`bindTouchControls()` (Phase 12 mobile pass)** — an IIFE run once at load, right after the canvas pointer wiring. Two pieces, both purely additive on top of the existing keyboard/pointer input — neither one is ever referenced from anywhere except the DOM elements it binds:
  - **Virtual joystick** (`#touchJoystick`/`#touchJoystickKnob`) — `pointerdown` on the ring captures that pointer (`setPointerCapture`) and remembers its `pointerId`; `pointermove` (which then keeps firing on the ring element even once the finger drags outside it, because of the capture) computes the drag vector from the ring's center, clamps it to a 38px radius, moves the knob via CSS `transform`, and sets `input.up/down/left/right` from a ±10px deadzone on each axis independently — so a diagonal drag sets two directions at once, exactly like holding two WASD keys. `pointerup`/`pointercancel`/`lostpointercapture` all reset every direction flag and snap the knob back to center.
  - **Action buttons** — `#touchBombBtn/#touchActiveBtn/#touchPillBtn/#touchStarBtn/#touchDonateBtn/#touchRerollBtn/#touchArcadeBtn` are one-shot `pointerdown` → the SAME `game.tryX()` calls the keyboard shortcuts use (`tryPlaceBomb/tryUseActive/tryUsePill/tryUseStar/tryDonate/tryReroll/tryArcadeInteract`), so a touch button can never drift out of sync with what its key does. `#touchTurretBtn` is held (`input.build = true` on `pointerdown`, `false` on `pointerup`/`pointercancel`/`pointerleave`) to mirror `KeyV`'s hold-to-channel behavior exactly. `#touchPauseBtn` calls the existing `togglePause()`. Every handler also calls `Sound.unlock()`, same reasoning as the keydown listener.
  - Visibility is entirely CSS-driven (`.touch-only` in style.css, gated on `not (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)` — a real touchscreen, not just a small desktop window), except `#touchTurretBtn`, which ALSO needs `js/ui/ui.js`'s `updateHUD` to toggle a `.hidden` class on it (mirroring the desktop `#resTurrets` chip's `hasTurretAbility` check) since turret-building is class-gated, not universal.
- `pointermove`/`pointerleave`/`pointerdown`/`pointerup`/`contextmenu` on `canvas`/`window` — converts pointer position to logical camera-space pixels (`input.mouseX/mouseY`), sets `input.mouseActive`, left-click→`attack`, right-click→`game.tryPlaceBomb()`, and suppresses the context menu.

**Pause/overlay screens**
- **`togglePause()`** — no-ops unless `game && game.state==='playing'`; flips `game.paused`, toggles `#pauseScreen`'s hidden class, releases/requests the wake lock accordingly, and (while pausing) fills `#pauseStats` (class/floor/coins/keys/bombs/kills/duration) and `#pauseEquipped` (active item/trinket/pill/star icons+names) from live `game.player` state. Wired to the Escape key and `#resumeBtn`.
- `#quitBtn` handler — confirms via `confirm()`, bumps `totalPlaytime`, hides the pause screen, calls `returnToMenu()`.
- **`openOverlay(id, buildFn, markSeenFn)`** — plays a click sound, calls `buildFn()` (e.g. `buildAchievementsPanel`/`buildBestiaryPanel`/`buildSkillTreePanel`), unhides the overlay, resets its scroll, calls `markSeenFn()` if one was passed (the Skill Tree overlay passes none — see below). Shared entry point for every button/keybind that opens the Achievements, Bestiary, or (Phase 8b) Skill Tree overlay.
- **`toggleOverlay(id, buildFn, markSeenFn)`** — open-or-close variant used by the T/C/K keybinds.
- Backdrop-click-to-close wiring for `achievementsScreen`/`bestiaryScreen`/`skillTreeScreen`.
- Button wiring: `pauseAchievementsBtn`/`pauseBestiaryBtn`/`pauseSkillTreeBtn`/`achievementsBtn`/`bestiaryBtn`/`skillTreeBtn` (open), `retryBtn`/`winBtn` (return to menu), `achievementsCloseBtn`/`bestiaryCloseBtn`/`skillTreeCloseBtn` (close). The Escape handler's open-overlay search array also includes `skillTreeScreen`.
- **`markAchievementsSeen()`** / **`refreshAchievementsBadge()`** — persist/read `nightfallAchvSeenCount` to show/hide the `#achievementsNewBadge` "NEW" indicator based on `unlocks.achievements` count.
- **`refreshSkillTreeBadge()`** *(Phase 8b)* — no seen/unseen tracking (unlike the two above); just mirrors `unlocks.skillTree.points` as `#skillTreePointsBadge`'s text and hides the badge when `points <= 0`. Also sets the badge's `title` to `"<lifetimeEarned> points earned over your lifetime"` when that counter is nonzero (post-capstone polish pass — see `checkBestiaryTierUp`'s entry above). Called alongside `refreshAchievementsBadge`/`refreshBestiaryBadge` from `updateLifetimeStatsDisplay()`, so it refreshes both at initial page load and every `returnToMenu()`.
- Mute button (`muteBtn`) and volume slider (`volumeSlider`) wiring, syncing to `Sound`'s state via `syncMuteBtn()`.

**Difficulty**
- **`DIFFICULTY_IDS`** = `['easy','normal','hard']`.
- **`loadDifficultyPref()`** / **`saveDifficultyPref(d)`** — reads/writes `localStorage['nightfallDifficulty']`, defaulting to `'normal'`.
- `currentDifficulty` — module-level cached value (not re-read from localStorage per enemy spawn).
- **`difficultyStatMult()`** — returns `0.75`/`1`/`1.5` for easy/normal/hard. Read once per Enemy/Boss construction in entities.js to scale hp+dmg; nothing else (player, items, drops) looks at it.
- `syncDifficultyBtns()` — toggles `.active` on `#difficultySelect`'s buttons to match `currentDifficulty`.
- `#difficultySelect` click handler — updates `currentDifficulty`, persists it, re-syncs buttons.

**Fullscreen**
- `FULLSCREEN_SUPPORTED` — feature-detect via `document.documentElement.requestFullscreen`.
- `syncFullscreenBtn()` — updates `#fullscreenBtn`'s title/aria-pressed/`.active` class.
- Click handler toggles fullscreen (swallows rejection); `fullscreenchange` listener re-syncs the button and calls `game.fitCanvas()`.

**Wake lock**
- **`requestWakeLock()`** — requests a `navigator.wakeLock` screen lock, guarded by feature-detect, current game state (`playing`, not paused), and `document.hidden`; releases immediately if the run ended during the async request.
- **`releaseWakeLock()`** — releases the held lock if any.

**Visibility/lifecycle**
- `visibilitychange` listener — stops the render loop (`stopLoop()`), suspends `Sound`, releases the wake lock while hidden; resumes all three when visible again.
- `blur` listener on `window` — auto-pauses an in-progress run.
- `beforeunload` listener — shows the browser's native "leave site?" prompt while a run is in progress.

**Menu tips**
- **`MENU_TIPS`** — array of rotating tip strings.
- **`showMenuTip()`** — picks a random tip into `#mainMenuTip`. Called from `updateLifetimeStatsDisplay()`.

**Screen/run transitions**
- **`startGameWithClass(classId)`** — stops the main-menu ambient drone (`Sound.stopAmbient()` — see `core/audio.js`), hides menu/end/pause screens, shows `#gameScreen`, constructs `new Game(canvas)`, calls `game.startRun(classId, readSeedInput())`, `game.fitCanvas()`, `requestWakeLock()`, then populates `#seedReadout` with `game.runSeed.display` (Slice D1 — seeded RNG; `readSeedInput()` reads `#seedInput`'s trimmed value, blank = random seed). Passed as the `onPick` callback to `buildClassSelect` (ui.js).
- **`returnToMenu()`** — releases the wake lock, stops any in-progress background track (`Sound.stopMusic()` — safe no-op if none is playing; covers a run ending mid-Crypt, e.g. dying there, where `game.js`'s `startFloor` never gets a later floor transition to fade it out itself), nulls `game`, hides all game/end/pause screens, shows `#mainMenu`, rebuilds `buildClassSelect`/`buildSuperbossTrophies`/`updateLifetimeStatsDisplay`, restarts the ambient drone (`Sound.startAmbient()`).
- **`updateLifetimeStatsDisplay()`** — fills `#lifetimeStats` with a one-line summary (runs/wins/playtime/enemies defeated/deepest floor/fastest win) from `unlocks.stats`, and calls `refreshAchievementsBadge()`/`refreshBestiaryBadge()`/`showMenuTip()`.

**Shareable run summary**
- `_runSummary` — module-level snapshot string (captured at end-screen time since `game` is torn down before the Copy button could be clicked).
- `CLIPBOARD_SUPPORTED` — feature-detect.
- **`buildRunSummary(won)`** — builds the shareable text (class, outcome incl. the C-branch's distinct ending text, coins/kills/duration). Slice D2: now a 3-line block — the original coins/kills(+boss kills)/time line, a second line of `game.runStats` (floors reached, rooms cleared, items collected), and a third `Seed: <display>` line when `game.runSeed` exists — still one copyable text block.
- **`wireCopyBtn(id)`** — wires a Copy button to write `_runSummary` to the clipboard with a brief "✅ Copied!"/"Copy failed" label swap; hides the button outright if clipboard isn't supported. Called for `copyRunBtn`/`copyWinRunBtn`.
- **`wireCopySeedBtn(id)`** (Slice D2) — identical flash-and-reset pattern to `wireCopyBtn`, but copies `_runSeedText` (just the seed string) instead of the full summary. Called for `copySeedBtn`/`copyWinSeedBtn`, the new buttons next to each end screen's existing Copy Run Summary button.
- **`showGameOver()`** / **`showWin()`** — fill `#gameOverStats`/`#winStats` with the run's outcome text (via `floorLabelFor`/`floorNameFor` from stages.js) and unhide the respective end screen; both set `_runSummary` (via `buildRunSummary`) and (Slice D2) `_runSeedText`. Slice D2: the stats text itself is also extended with boss kills/rooms cleared/items collected and a trailing `Seed: …` clause when `game.runSeed` exists.

**Canvas resize wiring** — a `ResizeObserver` on `#canvasWrap` (falling back to a `window resize` listener) calls `game.fitCanvas()` on layout changes.

**The main loop**
- `lastTime`, `lastState` — loop-local timing/state-transition tracking.
- **`loop(now)`** — the `requestAnimationFrame` callback: computes a clamped `dt` (max 0.05s), calls `game.update(input, dt)` then `game.render()` if `game` exists, and on a `game.state` transition: releases the wake lock and (on `gameover`) calls `showGameOver()`, plays the game-over sound, bumps `deaths`/`totalPlaytime` stats, and credits the killer to the bestiary (`bumpBestiaryCount('enemyDeaths', src, 1)`) if `player.lastDamageSource` is a real enemy/boss/superboss id; on `win`, calls `showWin()`, plays the win fanfare, `recordWin(game, classId)`, bumps `totalPlaytime`, checks/toasts a new fastest-win personal best (`setStatMin`), and unlocks the three speedrun achievements (`challenge_speedrun_20min/12min/8min`) independently based on `game.runElapsed`. **Menu-visual overhaul**: after the `if (game)` block, the loop calls **`renderMenuBackdrop(dt)`** (`ui/menu-backdrop.js`) whenever **`menuBackdropShouldRender()`** returns true — it is no longer tied to `game == null`, so the starfield now also renders behind the overlay screens that can be open while `game` is still truthy (game over / win in particular — `showGameOver()`/`showWin()` now also hide `#gameScreen` themselves, so the starfield actually shows through their semi-transparent backgrounds instead of the frozen last frame). Reschedules itself via `requestAnimationFrame`.
- **`MENU_BACKDROP_SCREENS`** / **`menuBackdropShouldRender()`** — the allowlist of top-level screen ids that get the starfield behind them (`mainMenu`, `achievementsScreen`, `bestiaryScreen`, `skillTreeScreen`, `musicTestScreen`, `settingsScreen`, `gameOverScreen`, `winScreen`) and the predicate that returns true if any of them is currently un-`.hidden`. It reads the DOM's `.hidden` classes directly — the same signal every show/hide path in this file already toggles — so there's no parallel visibility state to keep in sync. `#pauseScreen` is intentionally absent: pause is a dim overlay **on top of** the frozen game canvas and must keep reading that way, so with only pause open the gate stays false and the backdrop isn't drawn.
- **`rafId`** — doubles as both the pending frame handle and the "is the loop running" flag.
- **`startLoop()`** / **`stopLoop()`** — start/stop the rAF loop; `startLoop` resets `lastTime` so a long hidden gap doesn't arrive as one giant `dt`.
- Bottom of file: calls `startLoop()`, `buildClassSelect(startGameWithClass)`, `buildSuperbossTrophies()`, `updateLifetimeStatsDisplay()`, `Sound.startAmbient()`, `tryBootTestRoom()` to boot the page.

**Test-room boot hook (Pass B)**
- **`tryBootTestRoom()`** — called once, last, at the bottom of the file, after the normal menu boot. Reads `localStorage['adele2_testRoom']`; returns `false` immediately (no-op, normal menu boot stands) if the key is absent/empty. If present, removes the key right away (so a stale/malformed entry can never re-trigger on a later page load), then parses it with `/^ROOM_TEMPLATES\.(\w+)\.push\((.*)\);$/s` — the exact JS-source-text shape `roomEditor.js`'s `exportTemplate()` writes — capturing the room type and the JSON template payload; `JSON.parse` failures also abort silently back to normal boot. On success, calls `startGameWithClass('earth')` (Earth Pony chosen because `CLASSES.earth` is unconditionally `unlocked:true` in `data/core.js`, so this always works regardless of save state) to get a live `Game` instance through the normal boot path, then calls `game.loadTestRoom(template, roomType)` (game.js) to swap the freshly-started run's starting room for the decoded template. Entirely additive: with the key absent, `tryBootTestRoom()` is a single localStorage read and an early return, and every other boot step above it is unchanged.

### ui/menu-backdrop.js

*(Post-megaupdate main-menu polish pass; rebuilt into a parallax starfield by the menu-visual overhaul.)* An ambient canvas background rendered onto `#menuBackdrop`, a `position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:-1` `<canvas>` in `index.html` sitting behind `#app` (a sibling of it, not a child — outside `#app` so its full-viewport sizing never fights `#app`'s own layout; painted below `#app` regardless of DOM/z-index-tie order because `#app` is `position:relative`, which per CSS stacking rules always paints above any negative-z-index sibling). Purely decorative — additive to the pre-existing static `body::before`/`body::after` gradient-drift+twinkle layers in `style.css` (those are fixed-position, non-moving CSS glows; these are canvas particles that actually drift, giving the menus a sense of depth/motion the static layers alone couldn't).

Three visual layers, back to front: a **far star layer** (many small, dim, barely-moving, non-twinkling stars), a **near star layer** (fewer, larger, brighter, faster, twinkling, some palette-tinted), and the original **coloured drifting motes**. Plus occasional **shooting stars**.

- **`MENU_BACKDROP_PALETTE`** — the same five DNB-neon accent colors used across the rest of the UI (`--accent`/`--accent2`/`--gold`/`--red`/`--blue`). **`MENU_BACKDROP_COUNT`** = 46 motes, **`MENU_STARS_FAR`** = 60, **`MENU_STARS_NEAR`** = 30, **`MENU_SHOOTER_MIN_GAP`**/**`MENU_SHOOTER_MAX_GAP`** = 4/9 seconds between shooting stars.
- **`menuBackdropReducedMotion()`** — lazily creates and caches a `matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')` object in `menuBackdropReducedQuery`, then reads `.matches` per frame (a plain property read, and it stays live if the OS setting changes mid-session — no listener needed).
- **`ensureMenuBackdropSized()`** — lazily grabs the canvas/context, and re-syncs `canvas.width`/`canvas.height` to `window.innerWidth`/`innerHeight` every call (cheap — two property reads in the common no-resize case, so no separate `resize` listener is needed). A canvas's `width`/`height` ATTRIBUTES define its internal pixel grid — plain CSS sizing alone can't do this, hence doing it here instead of in `style.css`. A size change nulls both `menuBackdropParticles` and `menuBackdropStars` (forcing a reseed against the new bounds) and drops any in-flight shooting stars, rather than trying to reconcile old positions against new bounds — a star or two popping to a new spot after a resize is imperceptible.
- **`seedMenuBackdropParticles()`** — builds the 46 motes, each with a random `x`/`y`, radius, upward drift `speed`, sideways `sway` amplitude/phase/speed (for organic non-linear movement, not straight-line drift), a random palette color, and an independent alpha-twinkle phase/speed.
- **`seedMenuBackdropStars()`** — builds both star layers into one flat `menuBackdropStars` array (each star carries its own `speed`/`base` alpha/`twinkle` amplitude/`rate`/`phase`/`color`, so no per-layer bookkeeping is needed at draw time). Far stars get `twinkle:0` — a steady alpha is what sells them as distant; near stars twinkle and 35% of them take a faint palette tint so the field belongs to the game's colour scheme instead of reading as generic white noise.
- **`spawnMenuBackdropShooter()`** — pushes one shooting star: a random left- or right-travelling point at 25°–60° below horizontal, 620–1040 px/s, starting in the upper-ish half of the screen on the side it's travelling away from, with a 90–200px trail and a `ttl` of 0.45–0.85s (always under a second).
- **`updateMenuBackdropShooters(dt, ctx)`** — advances each shooter, splices it out once `life >= ttl`, and draws it as a `createLinearGradient` from the bright head back along its own velocity vector to a fully transparent tail (the taper is what makes it read as a streak rather than a uniform stick), plus a small bright head dot. Alpha eases in over the first 15% of life and fades out across the rest.
- **`renderMenuBackdrop(dt)`** — called from `main.js`'s `loop()` whenever `menuBackdropShouldRender()` is true (see that entry). Ensures sizing, lazily seeds both particle sets, clears the canvas, then: draws the star layers (advancing `y` upward, wrapping back in at the bottom with a fresh random `x`, applying the `sin()` twinkle), then the motes (same wrap, plus a `sin()` horizontal sway and alpha twinkle) — all driven off the shared `menuBackdropTime` accumulator, not per-particle timers — then ticks `menuBackdropShooterTimer` down, spawning a shooter and rerolling the timer into the 4–9s window when it hits zero, and finally draws the live shooters.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion:reduce` **in JS**: when `menuBackdropReducedMotion()` is true, `renderMenuBackdrop` draws the stars at their fixed `base` alpha and the motes at a flat 0.3, does **not** advance `menuBackdropTime`, does **not** move anything, never spawns shooting stars, and returns early. The field is therefore completely static but still visible as a designed background. (Previously `style.css` `display:none`'d `#menuBackdrop` entirely under that media query; that rule was removed as part of this pass, since a static field is the intended reduced-motion treatment.)
