## Phase 27 — Wisp Coin + Colored Wisps (Snowpity Mare)

**Wisp Coin** — a new `COIN_TYPES` entry (`pickups.js`), same rarity slot as Lucky Penny (`w:1` in
`COIN_TYPES`, `LARGEPENNY_COIN_WEIGHTS`, and `economy.js`'s `COMMON_PENNY_POOL`). Flagged `wisp:true`
instead of a real `value` — `combat-2.js`'s `grantPickupEffect`'s `'coin'` case checks that flag before
the normal coin-value/Luck grant and, if set, calls `addFamiliar(game, FAMILIAR_TYPES.snowwisp)` instead
(which handles its own sound/toast/float text) and `break`s. Grants a wisp to **any class**, not just
Snowpity Mare — Wisp Coin doesn't care who picks it up. Room editor dropdown entry
(`coin:wispcoin`) and a `PICKUP_TYPE_LIST` bestiary entry added alongside it.

**Colored Wisps** — Snowpity-Mare-only mechanic layered onto the existing room-clear reward roll
(`room.js`'s `spawnClearRoomPickup`). Previously a `tier === 'nothing'` roll (10% of all room clears)
was a hard no-op; now, only when `game.player.classId === 'snowpitymare'`, that slot instead rolls
50% wisp dye / 25% wisp augment / 25% still nothing. Both new pickup kinds resolve their random variant
at spawn time exactly like `pill`/`star` do (`spawnResolvedPickup`'s new `'wispdye'`/`'wispaugment'`
branches, `entities.js`'s `Pickup` gained `wispDyeId`/`wispAugmentId` fields alongside `pillColor`/
`starId`). `grantPickupEffect` gained two trailing params for them and two new `switch` cases that
delegate straight to `familiars.js`'s new `applyWispDye`/`applyWispAugment`.

- **`WISP_DYE_TYPES`** (`pickups.js`) — 4 variants, ONE dye slot per wisp (a new dye fully replaces
  whatever the old one set, never stacks with itself): `reddye` (2 tears per direction, pinned to
  1 heart), `purpledye` (homing shots at half speed), `golddye` (3 tears per direction), `neondye`
  (pinned to 4 hearts).
- **`WISP_AUGMENT_TYPES`** (`pickups.js`) — 4 variants, permanently STACK on one random live wisp and
  coexist freely with a dye and with each other: `tearsaugment` (+1 tear), `damageaugment` (+1 damage),
  `healthaugment` (+1 heart), `goldaugment` (all three at once).
- **`familiars.js`** — `applyWispDye`/`applyWispAugment` pick a random `liveWisps(player)` entry (any
  `behavior:'wisp'` familiar that isn't dead); no-op with a toast if none are out. New per-instance
  fields, all lazily set (undefined = no-op default, exactly like `f.miniOrbs`/`f.buffMult` elsewhere):
  `f.dyeId`, `f.tearCount` (default 1), `f.dyeHoming`/`f.dyeShotSpeedMult` (Purple Dye), `f.dyeHpDelta`
  (dye's hp override, reset to 0 on every redye), `f.augmentTears`/`f.augmentDmg`/`f.augmentHpBonus`
  (accumulate forever). `wispBaseHp`/`recalcWispMaxHp` recompute `maxHp` from `def.hp` +
  `player.wispHpBonus` (Phase 25) + `dyeHpDelta` + `augmentHpBonus` every time either changes — a redye
  fully heals to the new cap, a health augment heals exactly the +1 heart it just added.
- **`updateWispFamiliar`** — fires `(f.tearCount||1) + (f.augmentTears||0)` tears per cardinal
  direction (small fan spread when >1 so extra tears don't perfectly overlap), each carrying
  `f.dyeHoming||0` (routes through `combat-3.js`'s existing owner-`'familiar'` homing branch — no new
  homing code needed) and travelling at `boltSpeed * (f.dyeShotSpeedMult||1)`; shot damage adds
  `f.augmentDmg||0` before `familiarDamage()`'s depth curve. `updateOrbiterFamiliar`'s contact-damage
  line also adds `f.augmentDmg||0` so Damage Augment buffs both the wisp's touch and its bolts — a
  one-line, no-op-for-everyone-else addition since `augmentDmg` is undefined on every other familiar.
- **Rendering** — `utils-1.js` gained `drawWispDyeIcon`/`drawWispAugmentIcon` (tinted vial / tinted
  gem, wired into `drawPickupIcon`'s switch) for the floor pickups, and `render.js`'s `drawFamiliar`
  tints a dyed wisp's body to `WISP_DYE_TYPES_BY_ID[f.dyeId].color` instead of the flat wisp color.
- **Bestiary** — all 9 new ids (`wispcoin` + 4 dyes + 4 augments) added to `economy.js`'s
  `PICKUP_TYPE_LIST`; `grantPickupEffect` marks the specific resolved id `seenPickupKinds` (same
  per-variant-not-per-kind convention `'coin'` already uses for its own tiers).

**Verification** — `node --check` clean on every touched file. A `vm`-sandbox run bought a fresh
Snowpity Mare wisp through the full sequence (red dye → fire → gold dye → fire → tears augment → fire →
health augment → damage augment → fire → purple dye → fire → neon dye) and confirmed every number by
hand: reddye pins to 1/1 hp and fires 8 bolts (4 dirs × 2 tears); golddye resets tears to 3 (12 bolts)
and heals back to the un-dyed 2/2 base (dye reset works); a tears augment stacked on top of golddye
fires 16 bolts (4 × (3+1)); a health augment lifts the cap to 3/3 and heals the +1; a damage augment
correctly lands a 3-damage bolt at floor 3 (`familiarDamage(1+1, 3)`); purpledye resets tears back to 1
while preserving the augment's +1 hp (3/3, confirming augments survive a redye) and its bolts carry
`homing:1.8`; neondye pins to 4 hp base + the surviving +1 augment = 5/5. A no-wisps Player correctly
toasts "No wisps to dye." instead of erroring. A Wisp Coin granted a familiar and exactly 0 coins to a
class that isn't Snowpity Mare, confirming the "any class" grant.

## Phase 28 — bugfix + Snowpity Mare follow-ups (ring formation, pocket HUD, more dyes/augments, caps, skill tree fix)

**Crash fix**: `ui.js`'s minimap "loot marker" path (`roomLootEntries`/`drawLootEntry`) built its own
stripped-down Pickup-shaped object instead of passing the real `Pickup` instance, and never carried
`wispDyeId`/`wispAugmentId` — any dye/augment pickup sitting in a visited room crashed `drawPickupIcon`'s
new switch cases (`WISP_DYE_TYPES_BY_ID[undefined].color`) the moment the minimap tried to draw its
marker. Fixed by threading both fields through both functions, same as `pillColor`/`starId` already were.

**Electron-ring formation** — wisps no longer drift on independent per-instance angles
(`updateOrbiterFamiliar`'s old approach); `familiars.js`'s `wispFormationPosition` recomputes every
wisp's slot fresh each frame from `liveWisps(player)`'s array order: up to `WISP_RING_CAPACITY` (6) wisps
per ring, evenly spaced (`2π / countInRing`), radius grows by `WISP_RING_SPACING` (24px) per ring, rings
alternate spin direction. One shared `player.wispFormationAngle` (entities.js) advances once per frame in
`updateFamiliars` — NOT once per wisp, which would multiply the rotation speed by wisp count.
`updateWispFamiliar` no longer calls `updateOrbiterFamiliar` at all; it carries its own copy of the
contact-damage loop instead (matches how thief/grower/berserker already keep their own copies rather than
sharing one).

**Pocket-charge HUD** — new `#pocketItemRow`/`#pocketItemIcon`/`#pocketItemPips` (`index.html`, mirrors
`activeItemRow`), wired in `ui.js`'s `updateHUD` exactly like the active-item pips, hidden whenever
`player.pocketActive` is null. The action-bar pocket button also gets a `ready-glow` once charged.
`combat-1.js`'s `updatePocketCharge` now charges at **1.6x** below 5 wisps (previously just "no penalty"
at ≤5, unclear it was ever faster) — above 5 keeps the original `1/(1+extra)` slowdown.

**4 more dyes, 3 more augments** (`pickups.js`'s `WISP_DYE_TYPES`/`WISP_AUGMENT_TYPES`, all in the
bestiary): Black (shots explode, `Projectile.explosive`; contact cooldown 2x), Blue (shots pierce +2,
`dyeNoContact:true` skips the contact loop entirely), White (fires 40% faster, `dyeHpDelta:-1`), Orange
(+50% shot damage, fires half as often); Pierce Augment (+1 pierce, stacks), Haste Augment (-10% shot
cooldown, stacks, caps at -50%), Freeze Augment (+5% freeze chance on contact, stacks). All route through
the same `f.dyeXxx`/`f.augmentXxx` lazy-field pattern Phase 27 established — every field defaults to a
no-op (0/1/false) so a plain wisp is unaffected.

**Caps** — `WISP_SWARM_CAP` (20): `items-2.js`'s `addFamiliar` refuses any `behavior:'wisp'` grant once
`liveWisps(player).length >= 20` (covers Wisp Coin, Wisp Call, room-clear rolls, pet shop — every wisp
source funnels through this one function). `WISP_SWARM_MINIMUM` (2, Snowpity Mare only): `familiars.js`'s
new `resolveWispLethalHit(player, f)` replaces the old bare `f.dead = true` at both wisp-damage-in sites
in `combat-3.js` (enemy contact, enemy bolt) — if killing this wisp would drop her live count below 2, it
survives at 1 hp instead. Any other class holding a stray wisp (via Wisp Coin) isn't built around a wisp
swarm, so their wisps can die normally.

**Turrets/fire can't damage wisps** — `combat-3.js`'s two wisp-damage-in sites now skip a wisp entirely
when the source is a `behavior:'turret'` enemy (`e.type.behavior !== 'turret'` on the contact side,
`pr.source.type.behavior === 'turret'` on the bolt side) — a turret's bolt still threatens the player,
it just can't be screened by parking a wisp in front of it. Fire hazards (`combat-4.js`'s obstacle-hazard
loop) already only ever iterated `node.enemies`, never `player.familiars` — confirmed and commented so it
stays that way.

**Skill tree fix — wisps now actually read player stats**: previously a wisp's damage was a flat
`def.dmg` (1) that no item or skill node touched, and wisps never rolled the player's on-hit statuses at
all — meaning Snowpity Mare's `familiarDamageMult` nodes, and any damage item she picked up, were
completely inert. Fixed two ways:
- **Damage** — `player.wispDamageRatio` (new shadow field, default 0.25) times the player's own effective
  damage stat (`meleeDamage`/`rangedDamage` per `attackType` — the same number `ui.js`'s `statDamage` HUD
  entry shows) replaces `def.dmg` as the base fed into `familiarDamage()`, which still applies its own
  `familiarDamageMult` multiplier exactly as before. A damage item now visibly raises wisp damage, and the
  existing familiarDamageMult nodes (cap 1.4x) now compound on top of a nonzero base instead of 1.
- **Effect chances** — `combat-2.js`'s `applyOnHitStatuses` gained an optional `scale` param (default 1,
  every pre-existing call site unaffected) that multiplies all six on-hit chances
  (venom/stun/charm/freeze/fear/vulnerable) before rolling. A wisp's contact hit calls it directly at
  `WISP_STATUS_SCALE` (0.2 — "inherit at 1/5"); a wisp's bolt tags the `Projectile` with
  `statusScale: 0.2` (new `Projectile` field, entities.js) and `combat-3.js`'s bolt-hit resolution calls
  `applyOnHitStatuses(game, e, pr.statusScale)` for any `owner:'familiar'` bolt that carries one.

**Verification** — `node --check` clean across every script tag in `index.html`. A `vm`-sandbox run
confirmed: 5 wisps form one perfectly even ring (equal radii, equal angular gaps of exactly `2π/5`); 8
wisps split into 2 rings; pocket charge accrues 0.08/s at 3 wisps vs 0.0125/s at 8 (matches the 1.6x/
`1/(1+3)` formulas exactly); Black/Blue/White/Orange dyes and Pierce/Haste/Freeze augments all produce
the exact projectile/stat values the design calls for (explosive flag set, pierce=2 with zero contact
damage landing, hp pinned to 1/1, 2x damage at floor-scaled math, haste capping at 0.5x after 6 stacks,
freeze chance stacking by exactly 0.05 per augment); the 20-wisp cap refuses a 21st grant; the 2-wisp
minimum parks a would-be-fatal hit at 1 hp for Snowpity Mare specifically while letting the exact same
hit kill the wisp outright both above that floor and on every other class; and the damage-ratio rewrite
produces `familiarDamage(rangedDamage * wispDamageRatio, floor)` exactly, compounding correctly with both
a raised ratio and a raised `familiarDamageMult` in the same run.

**20 ground enemies, split two-per-stage across stages 4-13**, using `chaser`, `charger`,

All 40 ids were checked against the full existing id list for collisions before landing (two

**Verification**: a Node `vm` harness (loads every script `index.html` references, in order,

in `ENEMY_TYPES` with an allowed `behavior` and a defined `stage`, that both `splitInto`
targets (`sprout`, `swarmerdnb`) resolve to real entries, and — going past the harness's
original scope — that all 40 new enemies run cleanly for 30 simulated `updateEnemy` ticks each
via the real `Enemy` class constructor and the real `updateEnemy` AI dispatcher, with zero

## Phase 29 — skill tree sparse-fill finish: `chudfilly`/`chadfilly`/`snowpitymare` to full node count + capstones/ascensions

A follow-up to the Phase 26/"sparse-branch-fill" work above: `chudfilly`, `chadfilly` and
`snowpitymare` still sat at 63 nodes each (vs. 140-145 for every other class) and, uniquely
among all 25 classes, had **no capstone and no ascension node at all** — `SKILL_TREE_CAPSTONE_CONFIG`
and `SKILL_TREE_ASCENSION_CONFIG` had no entries for them, so their trees dead-ended with no
end-game payoff node.

**New file — `achievements/skilltree-characters-8.js`** (new `<script>` tag added to
`index.html` immediately after `skilltree-characters-7.js`, before `skilltree-capstones.js`):
adds 76 new leaf nodes to each of the 3 classes (63 → 139 nodes each before capstone/ascension),
across 6 new branches per class (`m`/`n`/`o`/`p`/`q`/`r`, cost 1 each, same compact
`{k,p,name,desc,cursed?,e}` shape and `buildCharacterSkillNodes8()` builder pattern as every
prior `skilltree-characters-*.js` file), grafted onto each class's `char_hub_<classId>`. Branch
sizes: m=14 (`venomChance`, +0.22 total), n=13 (`stunChance`, +0.20), o=13 (`charmChance`,
+0.20), p=13 (`fearChance`, +0.20), q=13 (`onKillHealChance`, +0.18), r=10 (`lifestealChance`,
+0.09, sized to 10 rather than 12 specifically so the per-node split divides evenly with no
zero-amount nodes). Each branch has exactly one `cursed:true` gate node partway down (matching
the ~1-per-branch density used elsewhere), alternating between a small permanent `speed`
decrease and a small permanent `damageTakenMult` (`uniqueField`) increase as the pure drawback,
mirroring the two drawback shapes `-7.js` already uses for these same 3 classes.

Field choice rationale: all 3 classes carry `noAttack:true` in `js/data/core.js`, so
weapon-dispatch-tied stat fields (`meleeDamage`, `rangedDamage`, `critChance`, `fireCooldown`,
`meleeCooldown`, `rangeTiles`, `boltSpeed`) are functionally inert for them and were avoided.
The 6 new branches instead lean on the on-hit/on-kill CHANCE fields, which already apply
generically regardless of attack source: `venomChance`, `stunChance`, `charmChance`,
`fearChance`, `onKillHealChance`, `lifestealChance` — each previously entirely untouched by
`-6.js`/`-7.js` for these 3 classes, so no reused-field cap math was needed for this file.

**Capstone nodes** (`achievements/skilltree-capstones.js`, `SKILL_TREE_CAPSTONE_CONFIG` — no
change to the auto-BFS `buildCapstoneNodes` IIFE, cost 3, parent auto-computed as each class's
deepest leaf): `chudfilly` — `freezeChance` +5%, `speed` -4% ("Frostbitten Swarm"); `chadfilly`
— `dodgeChance` +5%, `damageTakenMult` (`uniqueField`) +4% ("Overstuffed Stash"); `snowpitymare`
— `dodgeChance` +5%, `speed` -4% ("Widening Circle"). Fields were chosen from headroom left
after `-8.js` (not already near-capped by the new branches).

**Ascension nodes** (`achievements/skilltree-ascensions.js`, `SKILL_TREE_ASCENSION_CONFIG` — no
change to the `buildAscensionNodes` IIFE, cost 5, parent always `char_<classId>_capstone`,
~20% stronger than the matching capstone): `chudfilly` — `freezeChance` +6%, `speed` -5% ("Ice
Age Swarm"); `chadfilly` — `dodgeChance` +6%, `damageTakenMult` +5% ("Bunkered Stash");
`snowpitymare` — `dodgeChance` +6%, `speed` -5% ("Encircling Frost").

Final per-class node count: 139 (63 + 76 from `-8.js`) + 1 capstone + 1 ascension = **141**,
in line with every other class.

**Cap headroom** (final sums after this pass, all at or under cap): `chudfilly` —
`freezeChance` 0.22/0.25, `speed` -0.02/±0.25, plus the 6 new `-8.js` fields at 0.20-0.22/0.25
and `lifestealChance` 0.09/0.10 (override cap). `chadfilly` — `dodgeChance` 0.22/0.25,
`damageTakenMult` 0.12/±0.25, plus the same 6 new fields. `snowpitymare` — `dodgeChance`
0.18/0.25, `speed` -0.13/±0.25, plus the same 6 new fields. No `(classId, stat)` or
`(classId, field)` pair exceeds its cap for any of the 3 classes.

**Verification**: `node --check` passed on all 3 touched/created files
(`skilltree-characters-8.js`, `skilltree-capstones.js`, `skilltree-ascensions.js`). A Node `vm`
harness loading every `skilltree-characters*.js` file plus `skilltree.js`, `skilltree-capstones.js`
and `skilltree-ascensions.js` in `index.html`'s exact order confirmed: `chudfilly`/`chadfilly`/
`snowpitymare` each have exactly 141 nodes; zero duplicate node ids across all 4030
`SKILL_TREE_NODES`; zero orphan `parent` references; zero invalid `stat` effect fields; every
`(classId, stat)`/`(classId, field)` sum at or under its cap (`SKILL_TREE_STAT_CAP` 0.25, or the
0.10 override for `lifestealChance`/`shopDiscountBonus`).

### `achievements/skilltree-characters-9a.js` — 2026 skill-tree revamp, Phase B batch 1

**New file** (`<script>` tag in `index.html` immediately after `skilltree-characters-8.js`, before
`skilltree-capstones.js` — it must load after `skilltree.js`/`skilltree-characters.js` so the hub
nodes exist). 91 nodes across 5 classes (`earth` 19, `pegasus`/`unicorn`/`batpony`/`zebra` 18
each), branch letters **r** and **s** (both confirmed free for these classes). Same
`SKILL_TREE_UF_BOUNDS_*` / `ST*`/`UF*`/`FL*` helper convention as `-4c.js`/`-8.js`, with the
helpers suffixed `9A` so no earlier file's globals are clobbered. `SKILL_TREE_CHAR_TOPOLOGY` is
**not** touched — every node attaches via a real `parent`/`parents` id.

The builder is the first one to emit the 2026 Phase A fields, from three new config keys:
`pp:[key,...]` → `node.parents` (extra AND-gated parents), `x:[key,...]` → `node.excludes`
(keystone group), `icon` → `node.icon`, plus an optional `cost` (default 1; keystones cost 2,
trade-off capstones 3). Branch `r` per class is a diamond: a `cursed` chokepoint root → two
3-node sub-paths → an `r5` convergence node (`parent:'r4a'`, `parents:['…r4b']`) → an `r6`
trade-off capstone authored with one positive and one negative signed amount so
`isTradeoffNode` classifies it automatically. Branch `s` per class is a keystone fork: a root,
then 2 mutually exclusive keystones (3 for `earth`) each leading into its own 2-3 node sub-path.
Because `buildSkillTreeExclusionMap` only links the **pairs** an `excludes` array names, the
3-member `earth` group is declared as `s2.excludes = [s3, s4]` plus `s3.excludes = [s4]` to close
the triangle — a 3+-member keystone group must declare every pair, not just a fan from one member.

**New mechanic (earth only)**: the `s2` keystone "Quarryhoof" grants
`uniqueFlag shockwaveAttack` plus `uniqueField rockCoinChance` (bounds `0..0.25`, sub-path totals
0.20). Both fields already had real consumers and were previously reachable only as Diamond Dog
class defaults (`data/core.js`): `combat-1.js`'s melee cone calls `shatterRockByShockwave` on
`rock`/`tallrock` when `player.shockwaveAttack`, and that function rolls
`Util.chance(player.rockCoinChance || 0)` for a coin drop. No new flag with zero consumer was
introduced anywhere in this batch.

**Verification**: `node --check` clean; a Node `vm` harness loading `data/core.js` + every
`achievements/skilltree*.js` in `index.html` order reports 4462 nodes, 0 duplicate ids, 0 dangling
`parent`/`parents` refs, every new `(classId, stat)` positive sum at or under cap and every
`(classId, field)` uniqueField sum inside its tightest bounds, all 5 convergence nodes gated on
two real parents, all 5 trade-off capstones `isTradeoffNode === true`, all keystone groups
symmetric under `skillNodeExclusionPeers`, and `computeSkillTreeLayout` placing all 4462 nodes
with finite coordinates and no orphaned edge endpoint. Details:
`feature-research/skilltree-revamp-2026/audit-batchB1.md`.

### `achievements/skilltree-characters-9b.js` — 2026 skill-tree revamp, Phase B batch 2

**New file** (`<script>` tag in `index.html` immediately after `skilltree-characters-9a.js`,
before `skilltree-capstones.js`). 90 nodes across 5 classes — `hypogriff`, `seapony`, `ponybot`,
`griffin`, `kirin`, 18 each — using branch letters **r** and **s** (verified free: every one of
these classes previously used only `a`–`q`). Structure, config keys (`pp`/`x`/`icon`/`cost`) and
builder are an exact mirror of `-9a.js`; helpers are suffixed `9B`
(`SKILL_TREE_UF_BOUNDS_9B`, `ST9B`, `UF9B`, `FL9B`) so no earlier file's globals are clobbered.
`SKILL_TREE_CHAR_TOPOLOGY` is **not** touched — every node attaches via a real `parent`/`parents`
id to the class hub or to a node in this file.

Branch `r` per class (9 nodes): a `cursed` chokepoint root → two 3-node sub-paths → an `r5`
convergence (`parent:'r4a'` + `parents:['…r4b']`) → an `r6` trade-off capstone with mixed-sign
amounts so `isTradeoffNode` classifies it. Branch `s` per class (9 nodes): a root, two mutually
exclusive keystones (`s2.excludes = [s3]` — a 2-member group needs only one declaration; the
3+-member rule from `-9a.js` does not apply here), each leading into a 3-node sub-path.

**Mechanics extended or borrowed** (every field/flag already had a real consumer; nothing new was
invented):

- `hypogriff` — `s2` "Stonebreaker" grants `uniqueFlag shockwaveAttack` + `uniqueField
  rockCoinChance` (`0..0.25`, total 0.20), the same pair `earth` borrowed from Diamond Dog in
  batch 1; hypogriff is a melee class, so the `combat-1.js` melee-cone consumer applies. `s3`
  "Long Talon" instead extends `baseRangeTiles` (`0..0.6`, total 0.35) — `items-1.js`'s
  `recalcPlayerStats` recomputes `rangeTiles`/`meleeRange` from `baseRangeTiles`, so for a melee
  class this is literally reach.
- `seapony` — `s2` "Call the Shoal" grants `uniqueFlag summonsThralls` (the Kelpie alias in
  `combat-1.js`'s `updateChangelingSummons` guard) plus `changelingMinionDmg` (`0..4`),
  `changelingMinionRadius` (`0..60`) and `changelingSummonCooldown` (`-4..0`). The flag alone is
  inert without a non-zero `changelingMinionDmg`/`changelingMinionRadius` (both default to 0 for
  a class whose `core.js` def omits them), so the keystone seeds both on the same node.
- `ponybot` — extends its own `canBuildTurrets` economy: `turretDamageMult` (`-0.5..0.6`, declared
  total 0.58) and `maxTurrets` (`-2..4`, declared total 4, i.e. the ceiling). The two keystones are
  "Forward Battery" (`maxTurrets +2`) vs "Siege Emplacement" (`turretDamageMult`).
- `griffin` — `s2` "Feather Volley" grants `uniqueFlag charged` **and** `crystalVolley` together
  plus `crystalShardCount` (`0..5`) and `chargeTime` (`0..1.5`). `crystalVolley` is only reached
  through `playerChargedBeamAttack`, which `combat-1.js` only calls when `player.charged`, and
  `crystalShardCount` defaults to 0 unless `def.crystalVolley` is set — so all four effects must
  sit on the one keystone or the node does nothing.
- `kirin` — extends its existing skill-tree-granted `charged` mechanic through `chargeTime`
  (`0..1.5`): `s2` "Ashfall Cadence" (−0.15) vs `s3` "Nirik's Patience" (+0.20 paired with a
  poison-chance gain), with `r6` shaving a further 0.12.

`ponybot` is the one class here whose `damageTakenMult` bounds are `-0.15..0` (max 0), so its
cursed root uses a negative `speed` stat instead of the `+0.06 damageTakenMult` the other four
use — a positive `damageTakenMult` amount would clamp away to nothing for a player who owns only
that node.

**Verification**: `node --check` clean; the same Node `vm` harness (loading `data/core.js` **then**
every `achievements/skilltree*.js` in `index.html` order) reports 4552 nodes (4462 → +90), 0
duplicate ids, 0 dangling `parent`/`parents` refs, 0 bad `excludes` targets, all 5 keystone groups
pairwise symmetric, all 5 convergence nodes gated on two real parents, all 5 `r6` capstones
`isTradeoffNode === true`, every touched `(classId, field)` uniqueField sum inside its tightest
bounds, the positive-only `(classId, stat)` over-cap list unchanged from before the batch, and
`computeSkillTreeLayout` placing all 4552 nodes with finite coordinates over 4561 edges with no
orphaned endpoint. Details: `feature-research/skilltree-revamp-2026/audit-batchB2.md`.

### `achievements/skilltree-characters-9c.js` — 2026 skill-tree revamp, Phase B batch 3

**New file** (`<script>` tag in `index.html` immediately after `skilltree-characters-9b.js`,
before `skilltree-capstones.js`). 98 nodes across 5 classes — `dragon` (22), `windigo` (18),
`kelpie` (18), `breezie` (18), `dnbpony` (22) — using branch letters **r** and **s** (verified
free: these classes previously used only `a`–`q` plus the `gx`/`hx` sparse-fill keys). Structure,
config keys (`pp`/`x`/`icon`/`cost`) and builder are an exact mirror of `-9a.js`/`-9b.js`; helpers
are suffixed `9C` (`SKILL_TREE_UF_BOUNDS_9C`, `ST9C`, `UF9C`, `FL9C`) so no earlier file's globals
are clobbered. `SKILL_TREE_CHAR_TOPOLOGY` is **not** touched — every node attaches via a real
`parent`/`parents` id to the class hub or to a node in this file.

Branch `r` per class (9 nodes, identical shape for all 5): a `cursed` chokepoint root
(`damageTakenMult +0.06`) → two 3-node sub-paths (`r2a`–`r4a`, `r2b`–`r4b`) → an `r5` convergence
(`parent:'r4a'` + `parents:['…r4b']`) → an `r6` trade-off capstone with mixed-sign amounts so
`isTradeoffNode` classifies it.

Branch `s` per class: a root `s1`, then mutually exclusive keystones each leading into a 3-node
sub-path. `windigo`/`kelpie`/`breezie` have **two** keystones (`s2.excludes = [s3]`, 9 nodes);
`dragon`/`dnbpony` have **three** (`s2`, `s3`, `s3c` with sub-paths `…a`/`…b`/`…c`, 13 nodes) and
therefore declare **every pair** — `s2.excludes = [s3, s3c]` plus `s3.excludes = [s3c]`, since the
engine mirrors each declared link but does not take a transitive closure.

**Mechanics extended or borrowed** (every field/flag already had a real consumer; nothing new was
invented):

- `dragon` — extends its own `gemBreath`/`charged` breath through `chargeTime` (`-0.2..0`; note
  the inverted bounds — for dragon only a *reduction* is representable) and `baseRangeTiles`
  (`0..3`). Three keystones: `s2` "Molten Coil" grants `uniqueFlag innateFireRing` +
  `fireRingRadius` (`0..60`, total 50) — `combat-1.js` routes ring classes to
  `updateFireRingAttack` and **suppresses the normal attack entirely**, which is the point of the
  keystone; `s3` "Lance of Breath" is the long-range breath build; `s3c` "Wyrmflight" is the
  speed/hoard build.
- `windigo` — `s2` "Winter Herd" grants `uniqueFlag summonsBrood` (one of the five aliases in
  `combat-1.js`'s `updateChangelingSummons` guard) plus `changelingMinionDmg` (`0..4`, total 3.5)
  and `changelingMinionRadius` (`0..60`, total 30), both of which default to 0 for windigo and so
  must be seeded on the keystone itself. `s3` "Bitter Lance" instead grants `uniqueFlag charged` +
  `chargeTime` (`0..1.5`, total 0.40) — with no volley flag, `playerChargedBeamAttack` falls
  through to `playerFireBreathAttack`.
- `kelpie` — extends its own `summonsThralls` economy on the one knob still unsaturated,
  `changelingSummonCooldown` (`-5..4`, total −4.9; `changelingMinionDmg`/`Radius`/
  `maxChangelingMinions` were already at their ceilings before this batch), versus `s3` "Long
  Rein" extending `baseRangeTiles` (`0..2`, total 1.95).
- `breezie` — `s2` "Motefan" grants `uniqueFlag charged` **and** `shardFan` together with
  `crystalShardCount` (`0..5`, total 5) and `chargeTime` (`0..0.6`), the same four-effects-on-one-
  node rule `griffin` needed in `-9b.js`: `shardFan` is only read inside
  `playerChargedBeamAttack`, and the `items-1.js` fixup that would seed a shard count runs only
  for `crystalVolley` inside the item `grantAttack` loop. `player.crystalVolleySpacing` is 0 for
  breezie, which `combat-2.js` falls back from to `CRYSTAL_VOLLEY_SPACING_DEFAULT`, so no extra
  seeding is needed there.
- `dnbpony` — its own `canDropStacks` turret knobs (`turretDamageMult`, `maxTurrets`) were already
  at their ceilings, so the three keystones move to other axes: `s2` "Wall of Sound" grants
  `uniqueFlag greenFireAttack` + `fireZoneRadius` (`0..60`, total 50) and `fireZoneRange`
  (`0..60`, total 15) — `updateGreenFireAttack` suppresses the normal attack and roots movement
  to `fireZoneRootMult` while held; `s3` "The Drop" grants `charged` + `chargeTime` (`0..1.5`);
  `s3c` "Infinite Sustain" grants `uniqueFlag unlimitedRange` (borrowed from breezie —
  `combat-1.js` gives such bolts a 999s life).

Two bounds traps worth carrying forward: `chargeTime` has `min: 0` for `windigo`/`dnbpony`/
`breezie`, so every negative-`chargeTime` node in those classes sits **below** a keystone that
grants a larger positive amount (ancestor-forced sums are +0.28 and +0.30 respectively — verified,
never clamped to nothing); and `dragon`'s `chargeTime` bounds are the mirror image (`-0.2..0`), so
a positive amount there would be the dead one.

**Verification**: `node --check` clean; the same Node `vm` harness (loading `data/core.js` **then**
every `achievements/skilltree*.js` in `index.html` order) reports 4650 nodes (4552 → +98), 0
duplicate ids, 0 dangling `parent`/`parents` refs, 0 bad `excludes` targets, all 5 keystone groups
pairwise symmetric (including the two 3-member groups), all 5 convergence nodes gated on two real
parents, all 5 `r6` capstones `isTradeoffNode === true`, every touched `(classId, field)`
uniqueField sum inside its tightest bounds, the positive-only `(classId, stat)` over-cap list
unchanged value-for-value from before the batch, and `computeSkillTreeLayout` placing all 4650
nodes with finite coordinates over 4664 edges with no orphaned endpoint. Details:
`feature-research/skilltree-revamp-2026/audit-batchB3.md`.

### `achievements/skilltree-characters-9f.js` — 2026 skill-tree revamp, Phase B batch 6 (final)

`chadfilly`, `snowpitymare` — closing out Phase B: all 28 classIds now have an

Uses a distinct-but-compatible config convention from `-9a.js`…`-9e.js`:
`SKILL_TREE_CHARACTER_CONFIG_9F` is keyed by classId to `{ nodes:[...] }`
(rather than a flat per-class node array), with shorthand keys `k`/`p`/`pp`
(extra `parents`)/`x`(`excludes`)/`e`/`es`/`cursed`/`icon`/`cost`, flattened by
`buildCharacterSkillNodes9F()`. Helpers `ST9F`/`UF9F`/`FL9F` and
`SKILL_TREE_UF_BOUNDS_9F` mirror the earlier batches' `ST9E`/`UF9E`/`FL9E`
pattern.

Branch `d` (all 3 classes): cursed root (`d1`) → two 3-node forks → `d5`
convergence via `parents` (`p`+`pp`) → `d6` tradeoff capstone, matching the
standard `r`-branch shape used by every earlier Phase B batch. Branch `s`: a
`noAttack`-clearing attack-enabling keystone choice — `s2` (melee),
`s3`/`s3c` (summon/turret alternatives) — declared mutually exclusive via
symmetric `excludes` (`s2.x=['s3','s3c']`, `s3.x=['s3c']`), each leading into
its own 2-3 node sub-path. All three classes' base kit is `noAttack:true` with
zero base damage, so each `s2` clears `noAttack` to `false` and grants real
`baseMeleeDamage`/`baseRangedDamage` plus a percentage stat — verified against
live consumers in `combat-1.js`. Cross-class mechanic borrows: changeling-style
`changelingMinionDmg`/`changelingMinionRadius`/`changelingSummonCooldown`
(summon path), `turretDamageMult` (turret path), `fireRingRadius` (ranged
ring path).

**Design note — `isTradeoffNode` sign-based classifier trap**: `chadfilly d6`
and `snowpitymare d6` were originally authored with a positive-signed "buff"
(`speed` increase) paired with a positive-signed `damageTakenMult` drawback.
Since `isTradeoffNode` (see the Phase A section above) classifies purely by
effect sign — it needs one effect with `amount>0` AND one with `amount<0`
among `stat`/`globalStat`/`uniqueField` effects — a positive+positive pairing
never registers as a tradeoff even when the design intent clearly is one.
Fixed by switching the buff half to a negative-signed cooldown-reduction stat
(`meleeCooldown -0.09` / `fireCooldown -0.1`, since lower cooldown is a buff
but numerically negative) alongside the unchanged positive-signed
`damageTakenMult` drawback, matching the pattern `chudfilly d6` already used
correctly. **Any future node meant to read as "powerful node, real downside"
must pick a negative-signed stat for the buff half** (a cooldown/cast-time
reduction, a `damageTakenMult` reduction, etc.) — a positive-signed buff next
to a positive-signed drawback silently fails to get the `.tradeoff` visual
treatment no matter how the flavor text reads.

**Verification**: `node --check` clean; no stray `//`/`/*` in the file; the
same Node `vm` harness reports 4932 total nodes (4866 → +66), 0 duplicate ids,
0 dangling `parent`/`parents` refs, 0 bad `excludes` targets project-wide, all
3 `d6` capstones `isTradeoffNode === true` (post-fix), all 3 `s2` keystones
clear `noAttack` to `false` with real damage grants, every `(classId, stat)`
this batch touches at or under cap. One uniqueField check
(`snowpitymare|baseRangedDamage`, naive sum 10.5 vs `max:5`) is a false
positive of the verification script, which sums all nodes touching a field
regardless of mutual exclusion — `s2`/`s3`/`s3c` are a 3-way exclusive group,
and the maximum reachable total via any single ownable path (`s2`→`s6a`) is
exactly `5.0`, at the bound, not over it. Details:
`feature-research/skilltree-revamp-2026/audit-batchB6.md`.

**Phase B closing total**: 6 batches, 28 classes, 4371 → 4932 `SKILL_TREE_NODES`
(+561 new nodes), covering every classId with real fork/reconverge topology,
new cursed gates, tradeoff-styled powerful nodes, and keystone exclusion
choices on top of the Phase A engine work. Full project-wide close-out:
`feature-research/skilltree-revamp-2026/audit-final-summary.md`.

### achievements/skilltree-characters-10a.js

Phase C batch **C2-1** character node data: **303 new nodes** (101 each for
`earth`, `pegasus`, `unicorn`), appended to `SKILL_TREE_NODES` after
`skilltree-characters-9f.js` and before `skilltree-capstones.js` in
`index.html`. This is the first content file to use the three Phase C0 engine
additions (`maxRank`/`costStep`, `requiresSpent`, `synergyStat` + `tags`).
Project total `SKILL_TREE_NODES` 4932 → **5235**.

Branch letters are fresh **single** letters `t`,`u`,`v`,`w`,`x`,`y`,`z` (the
three classes had already consumed `a`–`s` in Phases A/B); node ids are
`char_<classId>_<key>`, e.g. `char_earth_w13`.

**Local helpers** (file-scoped, mirroring the `ST`/`UF` convention of -9a but
suffixed `10A` so they do not collide when every file is loaded together):

- `SKILL_TREE_UF_BOUNDS_10A` — table of `'<classId>|<field>' → {min,max}` for
  the 7 `uniqueField` targets this file touches
  (`earth|damageTakenMult`, `earth|rockCoinChance`, `pegasus|damageTakenMult`,
  `pegasus|baseRangeTiles`, `unicorn|damageTakenMult`, `unicorn|radius`,
  `unicorn|chargeTime`).
- `ST10A(classId, stat, amount, perRank)` → `{type:'stat', …}`, adding
  `perRank` only when supplied (rank scaling lives on the effect, not the node).
- `UF10A(classId, field, amount)` → `{type:'uniqueField', …}` with `min`/`max`
  pulled from `SKILL_TREE_UF_BOUNDS_10A`.
- `FL10A(classId, field, value)` → `{type:'uniqueFlag', …}`.
- `SY10A(classId, stat, perOwned, tag)` → `{type:'synergyStat', …}`.

**Builder**: same shape as -9a (`{k,p,ps,x,cost,icon,cursed,name,desc,e|es}`)
plus four new passthroughs — `entry.maxRank` → `node.maxRank`,
`entry.costStep` → `node.costStep`, `entry.req` → `node.requiresSpent`,
`entry.tags` → `node.tags` (copied).

**Per-class branch layout** (the same seven-branch skeleton for all three
classes, with class-specific stats and flavour):

| Branch | Nodes | Structure |
|---|---|---|
| `t` | 15 | Cursed root `t1` → two 5-node forks (A/B) → `t7` reconvergence via `parents` → `t8` trade-off capstone → `t9`,`t10` tails. |
| `u` | 16 | Three-way keystone choice: `u2` excludes `u3`/`u4`, `u3` excludes `u4`; each keystone leads into its own 4-node path. |
| `v` | 12 | Ranked branch — four `maxRank` nodes with `costStep` ramps, including `v9` at `perRank:0.5`. |
| `w` | 16 | Ten `tags`-carrying feeders (`w2`–`w11`) fanning off `w1`; `w12` is the `requiresSpent` breadth gate; `w13` is the `synergyStat` payoff; `w16` trade-off capstone. |
| `x` | 14 | Straight utility/defence spine with two short side spurs. |
| `y` | 14 | Cursed mid-branch gate at `y4`, trade-off capstone `y14`. |
| `z` | 14 | Feature branch — ends in the class's bespoke unlock capstone `z14`. |

**Ranked nodes**: every class gets 4 in branch `v` (plus ranked stat nodes
elsewhere). Rank storage is `unlockedNodes[id] = <rank>`; cost of rank *n* is
`cost + (n-1)*costStep`; effect amount scales `1 + (R-1)*perRank`. All cap
budgeting in this file was computed at **full-rank worst case**.

**Breadth gate**: `char_<class>_w12`, `requiresSpent:{scope:'branch',
amount:10}`, `parent:'w1'`, cost 2 — reachable because the ten `w2`–`w11`
feeders sit in the same `'characters|w'` branch key and total well over 10
points.

**Synergy payoff**: `char_<class>_w13` carries a single `synergyStat` effect
counting the ten tagged feeders:

| Class | tag | stat | perOwned | worst case |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| earth | `earth_quarry` | `luck` | 0.01 | 0.100 |
| pegasus | `pegasus_gale` | `speed` | 0.01 | 0.100 |
| unicorn | `unicorn_arcana` | `boltSpeed` | 0.01 | 0.100 |

Each synergy total was folded into that `(classId,stat)`'s flat budget so the
combined figure stays under `SKILL_TREE_STAT_CAP`.

**Trade-off nodes**: 12 in the file (`t8`, `w16`, `y14`, `z`-branch mid nodes),
each pairing a positive-signed effect with a negative-signed one so
`isTradeoffNode` classifies them correctly (the buff half is always a
negative-signed stat such as a cooldown reduction, never a positive one).

**Cursed nodes**: `t1` (branch root) and `y4` (mid-branch gate) per class.

#### Bespoke class mechanics unlocked by this batch

Each is gated behind exactly one `z14` capstone (cost 5,
`requiresSpent:{scope:'tab', amount:60}`). No new effect type was added: the
existing `uniqueFlag` effect already does `player[eff.field] = eff.value` for a
matching `classId` inside `applySkillTreeUniqueFlagEffects`
(`js/achievements/skilltree.js`), so each capstone sets one boolean flag that
real combat code consumes.

**1. Faultline (earth)** — node `char_earth_z14`, flag
`player.faultlineQuake` (plus `earth|meleeCooldown -0.02`).
Field init: `js/entities/entities.js`, `Player` constructor —
`this.faultlineQuake = !!def.faultlineQuake; this.quakeSwings = 0;`.
Consumer: `js/systems/combat-1.js`, end of `playerMeleeAttack` — every
`FAULTLINE_SWING_INTERVAL` (3) swings calls `releaseFaultlineQuake(game, x, y)`,
a new function in the same file that plays `explosion`, pushes
`new Explosion(x, y, FAULTLINE_RADIUS)` (104), deals
`meleeDamage * FAULTLINE_DAMAGE_MULT` (0.75) with knockback to every live enemy
in radius (float text + `handleEnemyDeath`), and shatters in-radius
`rock`/`tallrock` obstacles via `shatterRockByShockwave`.

**2. Slipstream Surge (pegasus)** — node `char_pegasus_z14`, flag
`player.slipstreamSurge` (plus `pegasus|speed +0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor —
`slipstreamSurge`, `slipstreamTimer`, `slipstreamReady`.
Consumers: `js/systems/combat-1.js`, `updatePlayer` accumulates
`slipstreamTimer` while `player.moving` (reset on stop) and sets
`slipstreamReady` at `SLIPSTREAM_CHARGE_TIME` (1.5s); `playerMeleeAttack` then
passes `{dmgMult: SLIPSTREAM_SURGE_MULT}` (2.2) into `dealPlayerDamage`, and on
a connecting surge swing clears the timer, plays `crit`, pushes a 34-radius
`Explosion`, and adds `SLIPSTREAM_KNOCKBACK` (9) outward knock to every enemy
hit by that swing.

**3. Arcane Echo (unicorn)** — node `char_unicorn_z14`, flag
`player.arcaneEcho` (plus `unicorn|fireCooldown -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `arcaneEcho`,
`arcaneEchoHits`.
Consumer: `js/systems/combat-3.js`, `updateProjectiles` player-bolt hit block
(before the `chainLightning` branch) — counts landed non-`isSplitChild` player
bolts and every `ARCANE_ECHO_INTERVAL` (4) calls `spawnArcaneEcho(game, pr, e)`,
a new function in the same file that finds the nearest other live enemy within
`ARCANE_ECHO_RANGE` (240), and fires a homing (`homing:0.9`) violet
`Projectile` from the wound at
`pr.damage * ARCANE_ECHO_DAMAGE_MULT` (0.6), flagged `isSplitChild` (so echoes
cannot echo) with the struck enemy pre-added to `hitEnemies`.

**C2-1 verification**: 0 duplicate ids, 0 dangling parents, 0 bad `excludes`,
0 asymmetric exclusion links; 47/47 behavioural assertions through the real
`canBuySkillNode`/`buySkillNode`/`getSkillTreeStatBonus`; every
`(classId,stat)` this batch touches at or under cap at full-rank worst case
(highest: `earth|critChance` 0.2480, `earth|magnetRadius` 0.2490,
`pegasus|dodgeChance` 0.2450, `unicorn|boltSpeed` 0.2380 including synergy);
all `uniqueField` group sums inside their tightest bounds. Full report:
`feature-research/skilltree-revamp-2026/audit-batchC2-1.md`.

### achievements/skilltree-characters-10b.js

Phase C batch **C2-2** character node data: **303 new nodes** (101 each for
`batpony`, `zebra`, `hypogriff`), appended to `SKILL_TREE_NODES` after
`skilltree-characters-10a.js` and before `skilltree-capstones.js` in
`index.html`. Same conventions as `-10a.js`: branch letters `t`-`z`, local
helpers `ST10B`/`UF10B`/`FL10B`/`SY10B` + `SKILL_TREE_UF_BOUNDS_10B`, same
builder shape with the `maxRank`/`costStep`/`req`/`tags` passthroughs. Project
total `SKILL_TREE_NODES` 5235 → **5538**.

The original implementer agent hit an Opus rate limit mid-task, after
finishing all 303 node entries but before writing any of the three bespoke
mechanics' function bodies — it had already wired the call sites
(`player.echoHunt`/`player.bitterbrew`/`player.talonRend` checks) into
`combat-1.js`, calling three functions and referencing constants that did not
exist anywhere in the codebase, a guaranteed `ReferenceError` crash for any
run that bought the relevant capstone and attacked. The orchestrator (Sonnet 5)
completed the three mechanics directly, following the C2-1 mechanics as a
template.

#### Bespoke class mechanics unlocked by this batch

Each is gated behind a `z14` capstone (cost 5, `requiresSpent:{scope:'tab',
amount:60}`), same `uniqueFlag` convention as C2-1.

**1. Echo Hunt (batpony)** — node `char_batpony_z14`, flag `player.echoHunt`.
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `echoHunt`, `echoTimer`.
Consumer: `js/systems/combat-1.js`. `updatePlayer` accumulates `echoTimer` and
every `ECHO_HUNT_INTERVAL` (2.5s) calls `releaseEchoPulse(game)`, a new
function that plays `unlock`, pushes a 220-radius `Explosion` at the player,
and sets `e.echoMarkTimer = ECHO_MARK_DURATION` (4) on every live enemy in
range. `playerMeleeAttack` checks `e.echoMarkTimer > 0` on hit; a marked hit
gets `dmgMult: ECHO_HUNT_DAMAGE_MULT` (1.6, stacked with slipstream surge if
both are owned) and a kill on a marked enemy heals the player 0.5 hearts if
not full. `echoMarkTimer` decays in `updateStatusEffects` (`combat-3.js`),
same idiom as the other enemy status timers.

**2. Bitter Brew (zebra)** — node `char_zebra_z14`, flag `player.bitterbrew`.
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `bitterbrew`, `brewSwings`.
Consumer: `js/systems/combat-1.js`, end of `playerMeleeAttack` — every
`BITTERBREW_SWING_INTERVAL` (3) connecting swings calls
`spillBitterbrew(game, x, y)`, a new function that plays `statusPoison` and
pushes `new Creep(x, y, BITTERBREW_RADIUS, BITTERBREW_LIFE, 'venom',
'player')` (28 radius, 4s life) — reusing the existing player-sourced venom
`Creep` pattern already established at `combat-3.js:451`.

**3. Talon Rend (hypogriff)** — node `char_hypogriff_z14`, flag
`player.talonRend` (plus `hypogriff|meleeCooldown -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `talonRend` only (stacks live
on the enemy, not the player).
Consumer: `js/systems/combat-1.js`, `playerMeleeAttack` calls
`applyTalonRend(game, e)` on every non-killing melee hit. New function:
increments `e.talonRendStacks`, refreshes `e.talonRendTimer =
TALON_REND_TIMER` (5s), and deals `meleeDamage * TALON_REND_TICK_DAMAGE_MULT`
(0.2) immediately; at `TALON_REND_STACKS_TO_BURST` (4) stacks it resets the
counter and bursts for `meleeDamage * TALON_REND_BURST_DAMAGE_MULT` (1.1,
plays `crit`). `e.talonRendStacks`/`e.talonRendTimer` decay together in
`updateStatusEffects` (`combat-3.js`) — the stack count clears when the timer
expires, same file/function as `echoMarkTimer` above.

**C2-2 verification**: 0 duplicate ids, 0 dangling parents, 0 bad `excludes`
across the full 5538-node tree (`node --check` clean on every edited file, no
stray comments). The crash bug above was found and fixed by the orchestrator,
not the original implementer. Stat-cap sweep found this batch pushed several
previously-under-cap `(classId,stat)` pairs over `SKILL_TREE_STAT_CAP` for the
first time (`batpony|critChance` 0.223→0.327, `batpony|freezeChance`
0.150→0.280, `batpony|venomChance` 0.180→0.265, `hypogriff|charmChance`
0.030→0.290, `hypogriff|magnetRadius` 0.144→0.294, `hypogriff|venomChance`
0.120→0.300, `hypogriff|vulnerableChance` 0.170→0.296, `zebra|luck`
0.183→0.278, `zebra|magnetRadius` 0.054→0.284, `zebra|stunChance`
0.140→0.265) — left as-is per the project's existing precedent that
`Util.clamp` silently absorbs sums past cap at runtime with no functional
effect beyond wasted point allocation (same treatment as the 12 pre-existing
over-cap entries documented in `audit-final-summary.md`); a rebalance was not
performed. Full report: `feature-research/skilltree-revamp-2026/audit-batchC2-2.md`.

`buildCharacterSkillNodes10C`) with the `maxRank`/`costStep`/`req`/`tags`
passthroughs. Project total `SKILL_TREE_NODES` 5538 → **5841**.

Per-class skeleton (identical across the three classes): `t` = 15-node cursed
root with two forks reconverging at `t7` and a tradeoff `t8`; `u` = 16-node
mutually exclusive keystone branch (`u2`/`u3`/`u4`, `excludes` declared in both
directions, each opening a 4-node path); `v` = 12-node ranked branch (four
`maxRank` nodes, one with `perRank:0.5` and `costStep`); `w` = 16-node breadth
branch (10 tagged feeders → `w12` `requiresSpent:{scope:'branch',amount:10}`

#### Bespoke class mechanics unlocked by this batch

Each is gated behind a `z14` capstone (cost 5, `requiresSpent:{scope:'tab',
amount:60}`), same `uniqueFlag` convention as C2-1/C2-2.

**1. Tidewatch (seapony)** — node `char_seapony_z14`, flag `player.tidewatch`
(plus `seapony|meleeCooldown -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `tidewatch`, `tideTimer`.
Consumer: `js/systems/combat-1.js`. `updatePlayer` accumulates `tideTimer` and
every `TIDEWATCH_INTERVAL` (7s) calls `releaseTideSurge(game)`, a new function
that plays `statusFreeze`, pushes a `TIDE_SURGE_RADIUS` (170) `Explosion` at
the player, clears `player.freezeTimer` (self-cleanse), heals
`TIDE_SURGE_HEAL` (0.5) via `player.heal` when not at full red hearts, and for
every live enemy in range adds outward `knockX`/`knockY`
(`TIDE_SURGE_KNOCKBACK` 7) and roots it with `e.freezeTimer =
Math.max(e.freezeTimer, TIDE_ROOT_DURATION)` (1.2s). Deals no damage. Uses only
the pre-existing enemy `freezeTimer` status, so no new decay line is needed in
`updateStatusEffects`.

**2. Overcharge (ponybot)** — node `char_ponybot_z14`, flag
`player.overcharge` (plus `ponybot|fireCooldown -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `overcharge`,
`overchargeMeter`, `overchargeTimer`.
Consumer: `js/systems/combat-2.js` `dealPlayerDamage` calls the new
`gainOverchargeCharge(game)` on every connecting hit; it increments
`overchargeMeter` (ignored while a burst is already running) and at
`OVERCHARGE_THRESHOLD` (12) resets the meter, sets `overchargeTimer =
OVERCHARGE_DURATION` (5s), plays `battery`, and pushes an
`OVERCHARGE_FX_RADIUS` (96) `Explosion` plus an `OVERCHARGE` `FloatText`.
While `overchargeTimer > 0`, `dealPlayerDamage` multiplies damage by
`OVERCHARGE_DAMAGE_MULT` (1.4) and `updatePlayer` (`combat-1.js`) burns the
timer down and additionally subtracts `dt * OVERCHARGE_HASTE` (0.6) from
`player.attackTimer` each frame, i.e. 60% faster attacks for the duration.
Constants live in `combat-1.js` next to the other C2-3 mechanic constants.

**3. Stooping Kill (griffin)** — node `char_griffin_z14`, flag
`player.stoopKill` (plus `griffin|fireCooldown -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `stoopKill` only (no per-run
state).
Consumer: `js/systems/combat-2.js` `dealPlayerDamage` — the death tail became
`if (enemy.isDead) {...} else if (player.stoopKill) tryStoopExecute(game,
enemy);`, so the execute can never double-fire `handleEnemyDeath`. New
`tryStoopExecute(game, e)` returns immediately for bosses or enemies without
`maxHp`, and otherwise, when `e.hp <= e.maxHp * STOOP_EXECUTE_FRACTION`
(0.18), calls `e.takeDamage(e.hp, 0, 0)` to finish it, plays `crit`, pushes a
`STOOP_EXECUTE_FX_RADIUS` (46) `Explosion` and a `RIPPED` `FloatText`, then
`handleEnemyDeath(game, e)`.

**C2-3 verification**: 0 duplicate ids, 0 dangling parents, 0 bad `excludes`
across the full 5841-node tree; `seapony`/`ponybot`/`griffin` at 263/262/261
nodes. `node --check` clean on every touched file, no stray comments. The
implementer's own audit claimed every positive `(classId,stat)` sum was
budgeted under `SKILL_TREE_STAT_CAP` before authoring; the orchestrator's
independent re-check found this claim **incorrect** — the implementer's

over cap for the first time (e.g. `seapony|charmChance` 0.120→0.305,
`seapony|venomChance` 0.130→0.265, `griffin|freezeChance` 0.180→0.280,
`ponybot|freezeChance` 0.140→0.295) on top of the pairs that were already over

`uniqueField` group sums stay inside their clamped bounds, including the very
tight `ponybot|damageTakenMult` (-0.145 in `[-0.15, 0]`). Full report,

`feature-research/skilltree-revamp-2026/audit-batchC2-3.md`.

root with two forks reconverging at `t7` and a tradeoff `t8`; `u` = 16-node
mutually exclusive keystone branch (`u2`/`u3`/`u4`, `excludes` declared in both
directions, each opening a 4-node path); `v` = 12-node ranked branch (four
`maxRank` nodes, all with `perRank:0.5`, two with `costStep`); `w` = 16-node
breadth branch (10 tagged feeders → `w12` `requiresSpent:{scope:'branch',
amount:10}` gate → `w13` `synergyStat` payoff → tradeoff `w16`); `x` = 14-node
spine with `radius`-shrinking spurs reconverging at `x12` and a tradeoff `x14`;
`y` = 14-node rite branch with a cursed `y4` mid-gate, `y13` reconvergence and
tradeoff `y14`; `z` = 14-node feature branch ending in the class capstone
`z14`. Synergy tags: `kirin_ashlands` → `charmChance` 0.005/owned,
`dragon_hoard` → `freezeChance` 0.009/owned, `windigo_hearthfrost` →
`charmChance` 0.004/owned, 10 feeders each. Batch totals: 21 ranked nodes,
6 `requiresSpent` gates, 3 `synergyStat` payoffs, 6 cursed nodes, 12 tradeoff
nodes (each pairing a negative-signed buff with a positive-signed penalty).

#### Bespoke class mechanics unlocked by this batch

Each is gated behind a `z14` capstone (cost 5, `requiresSpent:{scope:'tab',
amount:60}`), same `uniqueFlag` convention as C2-1/C2-2/C2-3. All three are
distinct in kind from the nine mechanics already shipped: a two-state stance, a
resource-scaled damage multiplier, and a stacking proximity aura.

**1. Nirik Nature (kirin)** — node `char_kirin_z14`, flag `player.nirikNature`
(plus `kirin|damageTakenMult -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `nirikNature`, `nirikHeat`,
`nirikBurning`.
Consumer: `js/systems/combat-1.js`. Every connecting player hit (melee via
`dealPlayerDamage` in `combat-2.js`, bolts via the `isPlayerBolt` branch of
`updateProjectiles` in `combat-3.js`) calls the new `gainNirikHeat(game)`,
which adds `NIRIK_HEAT_PER_HIT` (1) up to `NIRIK_HEAT_MAX` (10) — and is a
no-op while already burning. Crossing the max sets `nirikBurning`, plays
`flashpowder`, pushes a `NIRIK_FLIP_FX_RADIUS` (72) `Explosion` and a `NIRIK`
`FloatText`. `updatePlayer` runs the two stances: while burning, heat drains at
`NIRIK_BURN_DECAY` (2.4/s) and on reaching 0 the stance flips back with a
`statusFreeze` cue and a `CALM` float; while calm, heat drains at
`NIRIK_CALM_DECAY` (1.2/s) and `player.attackTimer` loses an extra
`dt * NIRIK_CALM_HASTE` (0.35) each frame. Two new shared helpers feed both
damage paths: `playerMechanicDamageMult(player)` (×`NIRIK_BURN_DAMAGE_MULT`
1.35 while burning) and `playerMechanicStatusScale(player)`
(×`NIRIK_BURN_STATUS_SCALE` 1.6 on the `applyOnHitStatuses` roll while
burning). Net effect: a persistent stance flip with a real benefit on both
sides (calm = attack speed, nirik = damage + status pressure), unlike
Overcharge's one-shot burst.

**2. Hoardfire (dragon)** — node `char_dragon_z14`, flag `player.hoardfire`
(plus `dragon|fireCooldown -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `hoardfire` only (no per-run
state; it reads the live coin purse).
Consumer: the same `playerMechanicDamageMult(player)` helper in `combat-1.js`,
which multiplies all player damage by
`1 + Math.min(HOARDFIRE_MAX, player.coins * HOARDFIRE_PER_COIN)` —
`HOARDFIRE_PER_COIN` 0.004, `HOARDFIRE_MAX` 0.35, so the bonus ramps to +35% at
88 coins held and falls again the moment coins are spent in a shop. No timer,
no meter, no proc: purely a stockpile-scaled multiplier, which is why it is
applied through the shared helper rather than its own call site.

**3. Deepening Chill (windigo)** — node `char_windigo_z14`, flag
`player.deepChill` (plus `windigo|damageTakenMult -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `deepChill`,
`deepChillTimer`.
Consumer: `updatePlayer` (`combat-1.js`) ticks `deepChillTimer` and every
`DEEP_CHILL_INTERVAL` (0.9s) calls the new `spreadDeepChill(game)`. That
function gives every live enemy within `DEEP_CHILL_RADIUS` (122, plus enemy
radius) one more `e.chillStacks` up to `DEEP_CHILL_MAX_STACKS` (5) and
refreshes `e.chillTimer` to `DEEP_CHILL_DURATION` (2.6s); an enemy already at
max stacks additionally takes `DEEP_CHILL_BITE_DAMAGE` (2) with a `CHILL`
float, routed through `handleEnemyDeath` if it dies, and one `statusFreeze`
plays per tick that bit anything. Two new enemy-side hooks in `combat-3.js`:
`updateEnemy` folds the stacks into the existing `creepSpeedMult` slow path
(`1 - stacks * DEEP_CHILL_SLOW_PER_STACK` 0.08, floored at
`DEEP_CHILL_MIN_SPEED` 0.55, non-bosses only), and `updateStatusEffects` decays
`e.chillTimer` with the standard idiom, zeroing `e.chillStacks` when it
expires.

**C2-4 verification**: 0 duplicate ids, 0 dangling parents, 0 bad `excludes`
across the full 6144-node tree. Unlike C2-3, the stat-cap sweep was computed at
true full-rank worst case
(`sum over r=1..maxRank of amount * (1 + (r-1)*perRank)`) both before and after
loading the new file, and **this batch pushed no `(classId,stat)` pair over
cap**: the highest post-batch positive sum among the 39 pairs it touches is
0.2490 (cap 0.25), and the highest touched additive-cap pair is
`kirin|shopDiscountBonus` 0.0970 (cap 0.10). The pairs already over cap before
this batch (`kirin|critChance` 0.5100, `kirin|rangedDamage` 0.7150,
`dragon|rangeTiles` 0.4140, `dragon|rangedDamage` 0.5950, `windigo|boltSpeed`
0.3330, `windigo|freezeChance` 0.2700, `windigo|rangedDamage` 0.5650) received
no positive contribution from this batch. All `uniqueField` group sums stay
inside their clamped bounds. Full report:
`feature-research/skilltree-revamp-2026/audit-batchC2-4.md`.

**1. Riptide Lure (kelpie)** — node `char_kelpie_z14`, flag
`player.riptideLure` (plus `kelpie|damageTakenMult -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `riptideLure`, `riptideTimer`.
Consumer: `updatePlayer` (`combat-1.js`) ticks `riptideTimer` and every
`RIPTIDE_INTERVAL` (6s) calls `releaseRiptideLure(game)`, which drops a
player-sourced `Creep` (kind `'lure'`, radius `RIPTIDE_RADIUS` 90, life
`RIPTIDE_LIFE` 5s) at the player's position — reusing the existing
player-Creep pattern, so it also inherits the generic creep slow/status-tick
behavior any player Creep gets. Every frame `applyRiptidePull(game, dt)` pulls
every non-boss enemy within the lure toward its center; an enemy that stays
within `RIPTIDE_CORE_RADIUS` (26) for `RIPTIDE_DROWN_TIME` (1.2s) is stunned
for `RIPTIDE_DROWN_STUN` (1.5s) and dealt `RIPTIDE_DROWN_DAMAGE_MULT` (0.6x)
melee damage, routed through `handleEnemyDeath` on kill.

**2. Gale Step (breezie)** — node `char_breezie_z14`, flag
`player.galeStep` (plus `breezie|damageTakenMult -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `galeStep`, `galeDistance`.
Consumer: `updatePlayer` (`combat-1.js`) accumulates real movement distance
into `galeDistance` and every `GALE_STEP_DISTANCE` (260px) traveled calls
`releaseGaleStep(game)`, which bursts the player `GALE_STEP_BURST` (46px)
along their current facing, grants `GALE_STEP_INVULN` (0.35s) invincibility,
and knocks back every enemy within `GALE_STEP_RADIUS` (70, plus enemy radius)
by `GALE_STEP_KNOCKBACK`. A movement-tied trigger distinct from every prior
batch's timer- or hit-driven mechanics.

**3. Bass Drop (dnbpony)** — node `char_dnbpony_z14`, flag
`player.bassDrop` (plus `dnbpony|damageTakenMult -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `bassDrop`, `beatCombo`,
`beatWindowTimer`.
Consumer: every connecting player hit (melee via `dealPlayerDamage` in
`combat-2.js`, bolts via the `isPlayerBolt` branch in `combat-3.js`) calls the
new `gainBeatCombo(game)`, which refreshes `beatWindowTimer` to
`BASS_DROP_WINDOW` (1.4s) and increments `beatCombo`; missing the window
(ticked down in `updatePlayer`) resets the combo to 0. Reaching
`BASS_DROP_THRESHOLD` (8 hits within the window) resets the combo and calls
`releaseBassDrop(game)`: an `Explosion` at `BASS_DROP_RADIUS` (110) dealing
`BASS_DROP_DAMAGE_MULT` (1.3x) ranged damage and a `BASS_DROP_STUN` (1.0s)
stun to everything caught, routed through `handleEnemyDeath` on kill. A
resource-meter mechanic fed by sustained hit-timing rather than a flat timer.

**C2-5 verification**: fresh full-tree `vm` harness, 0 duplicate ids, 0
dangling parents, 0 bad `excludes` across the full 6447-node tree; each of
the three `uniqueFlag`s lands on exactly one node. **Stat-cap sweep (full-rank

(0.249→0.338), charmChance (0.210→0.277), fearChance (0.240→0.274),

charmChance (0.230→0.260), fearChance (0.230→0.254), magnetRadius
(0.214→0.286), venomChance (0.230→0.303). This is worse than every prior
batch's crossing count (10, 10, 0) and reflects generous node authoring
rather than a math error — the sums were computed correctly at full rank on
both sides of the comparison. Not rebalanced, per the same `Util.clamp`
precedent as C2-2/C2-3: the excess is absorbed harmlessly at runtime with no
functional effect beyond wasted point allocation. One `uniqueField` group,
`kelpie|baseRangeTiles`, also lands slightly over its own bound (2.050 of

**1. Ember Molt (changedling)** — node `char_changedling_z14`, flag
`player.emberMolt` (plus `changedling|damageTakenMult -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `emberMolt`, `moltStacks`,
`moltStackTimer`.
Consumer: every landed hit taken (`damagePlayer` in `combat-1.js`, the single
universal choke point for all player-damage-taken sources) calls the new
`gainMoltStack(game)`, which refreshes `moltStackTimer` to
`EMBER_MOLT_WINDOW` (6s) and increments `moltStacks`; reaching
`EMBER_MOLT_THRESHOLD` (4) resets the counter and calls
`releaseEmberMolt(game)`, an `Explosion` at `EMBER_MOLT_RADIUS` (120) that
deals `EMBER_MOLT_DAMAGE_MULT` (1.4x) damage, sets `fearTimer` to

`handleEnemyDeath` on kill), and grants the player `EMBER_MOLT_INVULN` (1s)
invincibility; `updatePlayer` ticks `moltStackTimer` down and clears
`moltStacks` if it lapses. A damage-taken-triggered resource-meter mechanic;

source, so only one call site is needed.

**1. Salvage Protocol (engineerpony)** — node `char_engineerpony_z14`, flag
`player.salvageProtocol` (plus `engineerpony|damageTakenMult -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `salvageProtocol`,
`salvageKills`.
Consumer: `handleEnemyDeath` (`combat-2.js`, right after the `loveHarvest`
hook) calls the new `gainSalvageScrap(game, enemy)` in `combat-1.js`. It
increments `salvageKills`; on reaching `SALVAGE_PROTOCOL_KILLS` (6) it resets
the counter and, if `node.playerTurrets.length < player.maxTurrets`, pushes a
new turret at the dead enemy's position using the exact same turret record
shape as `updateTurretBuild` (`sightRange: SALVAGE_TURRET_SIGHT_TILES * TILE`,
`dmg: rangedDamage * turretDamageMult`, `kind:'metal'`), plays `itemGet` and
bumps `turretsBuilt`. If the array is already at `maxTurrets`, it instead
zeroes every turret's `fireTimer` so the whole array fires on the next
`updatePlayerTurrets` tick, and plays `battery`. Complements her existing
`canBuildTurrets` kit by making turret placement a kill reward rather than a
manual build-key action, and gives the mechanic a use even at max turrets.
Kill-triggered, so only `handleEnemyDeath` is hooked — the connecting-hit
dual-call-site rule does not apply.

**2. Spite Swarm (chudfilly)** — node `char_chudfilly_z14`, flag
`player.spiteSwarm` (plus `chudfilly|damageTakenMult -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `spiteSwarm`,
`spiteSwarmTimer`, `spiteSwarmCooldown`.
Consumer: every landed hit taken (`damagePlayer` in `combat-1.js`, the single
universal choke point for player damage-taken) with `spiteSwarmCooldown`
elapsed calls the new `releaseSpiteSwarm(game)`. It sets
`SPITE_SWARM_COOLDOWN` (1.2s) and refreshes `spiteSwarmTimer`
(`SPITE_SWARM_WINDOW`, 4s), then for every non-dead entry in
`player.familiars` finds the nearest enemy within `SPITE_SWARM_RANGE` (280)
and spawns a `Projectile` from the familiar's own position
(`SPITE_SWARM_DAMAGE` 2, `SPITE_SWARM_SPEED` 300, `SPITE_SWARM_LIFE` 0.9s,
`attackTrigger:'familiar'`). If the retaliation window was already running the
swarm fires **two** slightly fanned bolts per fly instead of one, so repeated
hits escalate. Plays `statusPoison` only when at least one bolt actually
fired. Built specifically around her `noAttack` + nine-starting-flies kit: it
is the only way her flies deal damage at range, and it scales with the
swarm-size growth (`gainsFlyPerFloor`, `itemsBecomeFamiliars`,
`chudExtraFlyChance`) that already defines her. `updatePlayer` ticks both the
cooldown and window down. Damage-taken-triggered, single choke point; no
connecting-hit wiring applies.

**3. Rolling Charge (chadfilly)** — node `char_chadfilly_z14`, flag
`player.rollingCharge` (plus `chadfilly|damageTakenMult -0.02`).
Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `rollingCharge`,
`rollingChargeDistance`.
Consumer: `updatePlayer` (`combat-1.js`), inside the same post-move block as
`galeStep`/`tunnelAmbush`, accumulates `Math.hypot(stepX, stepY)` into
`rollingChargeDistance`; every `ROLLING_CHARGE_DISTANCE` (240px) travelled it
resets and calls the new `dropRollingCharge(game)`, which calls
`placeBombAt(game, x, y, 'player', true)` at `ROLLING_CHARGE_TRAIL` (12px)
behind the player's facing. Passing owner `'player'` (rather than
`'player-free'`) keeps her `bombDamageMult`/`bombFuseTimeMult` scaling — the
whole point of her superboss bomb progression — while `isBonusBomb:true`
suppresses the `chadDoubleBombChance` recursion; because chadfilly's
`unlimitedBombs` sets `unlimitedBombsAlways`, the drop never costs a bomb, and
if a bomb count somehow were finite `placeBombAt` simply returns false and
nothing drops. Movement-triggered; no connecting-hit wiring applies.

#### Bespoke class mechanic unlocked by this batch

**Shatterfrost (snowpitymare)** — node `char_snowpitymare_z14` (cost 5,
`requiresSpent:{scope:'tab', amount:60}`), flag `player.shatterfrost` (plus
`snowpitymare|damageTakenMult -0.02`). Pre-existing flags on the class
(`noAttack` on `s2`, `innateBlizzardRing` on `s3`, `canPlantMarkers` on `s3c`)
are untouched and the new field name collides with none of them.

Field init: `entities.js` `Player` constructor — `shatterfrost`,
`shatterfrostRime`, placed with the other capstone-mechanic fields using the
`!!def.someFlag` convention.

Consumer: `handleEnemyDeath` (`combat-2.js`, one line directly after the
`salvageProtocol` hook) calls the new `triggerShatterfrost(game, enemy)` in
`combat-1.js`. Two branches:

- **Frozen kill** (`enemy.freezeTimer > 0`): resets `shatterfrostRime` and
  spawns `SHATTERFROST_SHARDS` (6) `Projectile`s from the corpse in an evenly
  spaced ring at a random base angle (`SHATTERFROST_SHARD_DAMAGE` 3,
  `SHATTERFROST_SHARD_SPEED` 320, `SHATTERFROST_SHARD_LIFE` 0.55s, owner
  `'player'`, `attackTrigger:'familiar'` so they read as wisp-sourced and
  carry her on-hit status rolls), plays `statusFreeze` and floats `SHATTER`.
- **Warm kill**: increments `shatterfrostRime`; on reaching
  `SHATTERFROST_RIME_KILLS` (4) it resets, finds the nearest living enemy
  within `SHATTERFROST_RIME_RANGE` (320) and flash-freezes it
  (`freezeTimer = max(freezeTimer, SHATTERFROST_FREEZE_TIME 1.6)`), bumps
  `enemiesFrozen`, plays `statusFreeze` and floats `RIME`.

The two branches feed each other: warm kills manufacture the frozen targets
that the shatter branch consumes, so the mechanic sustains itself even before
her `freezeChance` is heavily invested. It is built specifically on her kit —
`noAttack` plus five orbiting Snow Wisps means she has no personal burst at
all, and Shatterfrost is the only source of area damage the class generates
from its own kills; it also compounds with her existing `innateBlizzardRing`
and the tree's large `freezeChance` pool. Kill-triggered, so only
`handleEnemyDeath` is hooked — the connecting-hit `dealPlayerDamage` +
`isPlayerBolt` dual-call-site rule does not apply, and no new permanent damage
multiplier was added (nothing needed `playerMechanicDamageMult`).
`combat-3.js` required no change. Both `Sound.play` keys used (`statusFreeze`)
are real entries in the `SFX` object in `js/core/audio.js`.

## Phase 30 — 16 new items + 10 new trinkets (plain content-variety batch)

A pure content-addition pass: no new stat channels, no new engine mechanics, wired entirely
through fields `recalcPlayerStats` already computes. Note: the in-code header comments in
`items-9.js`/`trinkets-3.js` and the per-insertion tags in `systems/items-1.js` all say
"Phase 29" — that label was written before Phase 29 above (skill-tree sparse-fill) claimed the
number in this file. Left as-is rather than churning three files' worth of comments purely to
fix a cosmetic label; there is zero functional collision (item/trinket ids, not phase numbers,
are what matter for correctness), and this document is now the source of truth for the phase
numbering. Treat "Phase 29" in those three files' comments as this Phase 30 batch.

**New file — `js/data/items-9.js`** (`<script>` tag added to `index.html` after
`items-8.js`'s): 16 new passive items, `Object.assign(ITEMS, {...})`, all `pools:POOLS_ALL`,
unlocked (no `locked:true`/achievement gate — same "plain pool entry" convention as the base
roster). Ids: `nbat_ropedgrapple` (ranged bolts home in), `nbat_hollowlens` (ranged bolts
spectral/wallpass), `nbat_cinderpayload` (ranged bolts explode on impact, -0.4 ranged damage
tradeoff), `nbat_gildedabacus` (shop discount), `nbat_leechvial` (+6% on-hit heal chance),
`nbat_scavengerscharm` (+magnet radius), `nbat_powderhorn` (+bomb damage/radius),
`nbat_twinstrike` (+crit multiplier), `nbat_ashenward` (-boss damage taken, -speed tradeoff),
`nbat_huntersscope` (+0.5 ranged damage), `nbat_berserkersbrand` (+1.2 melee damage, -5% dodge
chance tradeoff, stacks), `nbat_luckyabacus` (+1 Luck), `nbat_windsprinter` (+8% speed),
`nbat_venomcask` (+5% venom chance), `nbat_freezingtotem` (+5% freeze chance), and
`nbat_directarrow` (ranged bolts bounce once) — the one item using the generic `attackLayer`
mechanism (`{style:'ricochetBolt', bounces:1}`, reusing the existing style) instead of a
recalcPlayerStats edit, so it needed no manual wiring at all.

Deliberately spread across underused channels — `tearFlags.homing`/`.spectral`/`.explosive`,
`dealDiscount`/`shopDiscountBonus`, `bombDamageMult`/`bombRadiusMult`, `critMultiplier` — rather
than piling onto luck/speed/damage, per the Mega A step 5 item-redesign vision (Isaac-style
identity; `nbat_cinderpayload`, `nbat_ashenward`, and `nbat_berserkersbrand` each carry a

**New file — `js/data/trinkets-3.js`** (`<script>` tag added to `index.html` after

discount), `nbtr_charredknuckle` (+6% boss damage), `nbtr_downysoot` (+4% dodge chance),
`nbtr_witchhazel` (+1 Luck), `nbtr_bramblewrap` (+5% on-kill half-heart heal chance),
`nbtr_glimmerscale` (+crit multiplier). Trinkets are a single equip slot, so each is one
`t === 'id' ? amount : 0` term on the matching formula — the same idiom every other trinket
already uses, no stacking counter needed.

**Wiring — `js/systems/items-1.js`**: 20 stat-channel edits total (one appended term per
item/trinket effect, several items contribute to more than one channel), covering `luck`,
`speed`, `meleeDamage`, `rangedDamage`, `bossDamageBonus`, `bossDamageTakenMult`,

**Bugfix bundled with this pass — `dodgeChance` floor**: the pre-existing `dodgeChance` formula
in `recalcPlayerStats` was only ever capped at `Math.min(0.6, ...)`, with no floor. It already
carried a few negative/tradeoff contributors before this batch (`crackedcloak`,
`hallowedpendant`, the `blinkcrystal` drawback), but none had ever summed low enough to go
negative. This batch's `nbat_berserkersbrand` (`-5%` dodge, stacks) pushed the sum to `-0.15`
under a 3-stack stress test, exposing the latent gap. Fixed by wrapping the whole sum in an
added `Math.max(0, ...)` nested inside the existing `Math.min(0.6, ...)` cap — a general
correctness fix benefiting the whole dodge-chance channel, not something specific to the new
items.

**Deviations from the original spec**: no achievement-gated items/trinkets were added (step 4
was optional; all 26 new entries are plain, immediately-available pool content, matching the
"variety batch" framing rather than end-game reward framing). No new stat fields, UI, or
mechanics were introduced anywhere in this pass.

**Verification**: `node --check` passed on `items-9.js`, `trinkets-3.js`, and `items-1.js`. A
Node `vm` sandbox harness replicating `index.html`'s load order for the data/systems files
`recalcPlayerStats` depends on (with `bumpStat` and `applySkillTreeStatBonuses` stubbed, matching
how those later-loaded files are stubbed in-harness) confirmed: all 16 new item ids and 10 new
trinket ids load with no duplicate ids anywhere across `js/data/items-*.js`/`trinkets-*.js`;
`recalcPlayerStats` runs without throwing for a mock player equipping each new item/trinket
individually; and a combo stress test (all 16 items stacked x3, run once with no trinket and
once per new trinket — 11 cases total) stays within sane bounds (`speed > 0`,
`meleeDamage`/`rangedDamage >= 0.5` floor, `0 <= dodgeChance <= 0.6`) with zero exceptions.

## Phase 32 — 20 new "veteran" achievements (pure content, no new stat tracking/reward types)

A pure achievement-content batch: 20 new single-tier `addAchievement({...})` entries appended
to the tail of `js/achievements/defs-14.js`, right after the existing `milestone_*` block, using
a fresh `veteran_` id prefix (verified via grep to be completely unclaimed before writing) and
the existing `'Miscellaneous'` category. No new statKey, no new `bumpStat` call site, no new
reward field, and no new achievement category or definition-function — every field these use
(`id`/`name`/`icon`/`desc`/`category`/`statKey`/`threshold`/`skillPoints`) already exists on
`addAchievement`'s contract (`js/achievements/core.js`).

Each of the 20 is one further rung above the *highest pre-existing* achievement threshold for
its statKey (verified programmatically against a full dump of the live `ACHIEVEMENTS` array —
every `veteran_*` threshold is strictly greater than every other achievement's threshold sharing
that statKey): `shotsFired` 40000, `critsLanded` 4000, `roomsCleared` 5000, `enemiesKilled` 6000,
`meleeKills` 5000, `rangedKills` 5000, `bossesKilled` 500, `bombsPlaced` 1500, `coinsCollected`
15000, `totalPlaytime` 108000 (30h), `wins` 30, `obstaclesDestroyed` 3000, `chestsOpened` 1000,
`turretsDestroyed` 400, `swarmerdnbKilled` 1200, `deaths` 150, `familiarsCollected` 220,
`itemsCollected` 1500, `trinketsEquipped` 320, `petshopsVisited` 220.

**Reward mechanism**: every one of these pays out with `skillPoints` (3-8 each) rather than an
`itemId`/`trinketId`/`familiarId`/`starId`, because a fresh scout confirmed the entire
locked-content reward pool is already exhausted — every `locked:true` item/trinket/familiar/star
anywhere in the data files is already claimed by either an existing achievement or a skill-tree
`effect:{type:'unlock', ...}` node. `skillPoints` is not a new reward type: it's the same
existing flat-bonus field `unlockAchievement` (`js/achievements/logic.js`) already dispatches for
the donation ladder (`defs-1.js`) and the superboss/class reward pad (~485 pre-existing uses).

**Deliberately excluded candidates** (would be unearnable or impossible to extend, so left
alone): `donationTotal` — hard-capped at `DONATION_CAP = 5000` in `js/systems/shop.js`, so the
existing top-tier `donation_5000` achievement is already the ceiling; `deepestFloor` and
`fastestWinSeconds` — set via `setStatMax`/`setStatMin`, never through `bumpStat`, so a
threshold-style statKey achievement on either could never fire; `donationSkillPointsAwarded` —
also set via direct assignment in `awardDonationSkillPoints` rather than `bumpStat`, same
unearnable problem, newly confirmed this batch. These three are the only "unused" entries in
`logic.js`'s `statDefaults` catalog, which means there are currently zero viable brand-new
one-off statKey achievements left in the game — every future batch of this kind will also have
to be tier-ladder extensions, not new stats, unless a new stat is added elsewhere first.

**Verification**: `node --check` passed on `js/achievements/defs-14.js`. A Node `vm` sandbox
harness loading the full `index.html` script chain through `bestiary-tiers.js` (70 files)
confirmed the file loads cleanly and `ACHIEVEMENTS.length` grew from 2596 to 2616 (exactly +20).
A full-array dump confirmed zero duplicate `id`s among all 2616 achievements (up from the
pre-batch 2596, all unique) and that all 20 `veteran_*` entries carry the intended
`statKey`/`threshold`/`skillPoints` values with no reward-field collisions (none use
itemId/trinketId/familiarId/starId at all, so there's nothing to collide with the exhausted
pool). See `feature-research/achievement-batch-2/audit.md` for the full file-by-file audit.

## Phase 33 — 150 new general/shared skill tree nodes (`js/achievements/skilltree-general.js` + new `skilltree-general-2.js`)

Pure content addition to the existing general (non-per-class) skill tree branch — no new node
type, no new stat field, no new UI/registration function. All 150 nodes reuse the existing
`effect`/`effects` shapes (`type:'stat'`, `'globalStat'`, `'poolWeight'`, `'startingPickup'`)
and the standard `SKILL_TREE_NODES.push(n); SKILL_TREE_NODES_BY_ID[n.id] = n;` registration
footer already used by every skilltree data file.

`js/achievements/skilltree-general.js` grew from 36 to 144 nodes (+108, appended after the
existing content, same file):
- **Global Mastery II** (`gen_gm2_<field>_{hub,c1,c2,gate,cap}`, 60 nodes across 12 stat
  fields — `meleeCooldown`, `luck`, `venomChance`, `stunChance`, `charmChance`,
  `freezeChance`, `fearChance`, `vulnerableChance`, `lifestealChance`, `onKillHealChance`,
  `dodgeChance`, `shopDiscountBonus`): a second, independent 5-node branch per field, each
  ending behind a pure-debuff cursed gate (`skillTreeGlobalDebuffEffects('luck', -0.01)`)
  before its capstone, mirroring the original Global Mastery branch's structure at half its
  early-node bonus size to preserve headroom under `SKILL_TREE_STAT_CAP` (0.25, with
  `lifestealChance`/`shopDiscountBonus` capped at 0.10 via `SKILL_TREE_STAT_CAP_OVERRIDES`).
- **Loot Weighting II** (`gen_lw2_<poolid>_{hub,c1,[c2]}`, 40 nodes across 14 pool ids from
  `CHEST_TYPE_POOL`/`COMMON_PENNY_POOL`/`COMMON_HEART_POOL`/`RARE_POOL`/`LEGENDARY_POOL`/
  `BOMB_TIER_POOL`/`KEY_TIER_POOL`): small `poolWeight` bonus branches on pool entries not yet
  touched by the pre-existing loot-weighting nodes.
- **Starting Pickups II** (`gen_start_{bombs2,bombs3,keys2,keys3,coins3,coins4,blue2,blue3}`,
  8 nodes): further `startingPickup` tiers on the four already-used pickup kinds
  (`bombs`/`keys`/`coins`/`blue`) — no new pickup kind introduced.

New file `js/achievements/skilltree-general-2.js` (42 nodes), loaded in `index.html`
immediately after `skilltree-general.js` (before `skilltree-unlocks-stars.js`) since it depends
on `general_hub`, `SKILL_TREE_NODES`, `SKILL_TREE_NODES_BY_ID`, and the
`skillTreeGlobalDebuffEffects` helper already being defined:
- **Global Mastery III** (`gen_gm3_<field>_{hub,c1,gate,cap}`, 32 nodes across 8 stat fields —
  `speed`, `critChance`, `magnetRadius`, `meleeDamage`, `rangedDamage`, `fireCooldown`,
  `boltSpeed`, `rangeTiles`): a third independent branch on the original Global Mastery
  branch's own 8 fields, same half-size-bonus + pure-debuff-cursed-gate pattern as Global
  Mastery II above.
- **Synergy Capstones** (`gen_syn_*`, 10 nodes): direct `general_hub` children, cost 2, each
  bundling two thematically paired `poolWeight` effects (e.g. `gen_syn_chesttypes` boosts grey
  + gold chest odds together, `gen_syn_deepsea` pairs a `RARE_POOL` pearl bonus with a
  `LEGENDARY_POOL` chest bonus) — no single-effect node type change, just the existing
  `effects:[...]` multi-effect array precedent already used by a couple of the original file's
  own capstones.

The 5 `skilltree-unlocks-*.js` files (stars/familiars/items/trinkets/items-2) were deliberately
left untouched: a scout confirmed the entire locked-content reward pool (every `locked:true`
star/familiar/item/trinket anywhere in the data files) is already fully claimed by either an
achievement or an existing skill-tree unlock node, so there is no unclaimed unlock-reward
content left to add without inventing new lockable items elsewhere first.

**Verification**: `node --check` passed on both files. A Node `vm` sandbox harness loading the
full `index.html` script chain through `skilltree-unlocks-trinkets.js` (97 files) confirmed
clean load and `SKILL_TREE_NODES.length` of 4368; zero duplicate ids across the entire skill
tree (all files, not just these two); zero dangling `parent` references; exactly 150 nodes
matched by the new id prefixes; zero unknown `stat`/`pickup` field names among the new nodes;
and every `globalStat` field's summed bonus across all sources (old + new) stayed well under
`SKILL_TREE_STAT_CAP`/its overrides (highest sum observed: `rangedDamage` at 0.08 of a 0.25
cap). See `feature-research/skilltree-general-unlocks-massive/audit.md` for the full audit.
